jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Clayco is a full\-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. With $8\.1 billion in revenue for 2025, Clayco specializes in the "art and science of building," providing fast track, efficient solutions for mission critical, industrial, life sciences, power \& energy, aviation, commercial, institutional, residential and sports \& entertainment related building projects. **The Role We Want You For** We are looking for a highly adaptable **Software Engineer** to join our Application Development team. This role is ideal for a full\-stack developer who enjoys working directly with business users, rapidly turning ideas into solutions, and using modern AI development tools to accelerate software delivery. A key part of this role will be partnering with business users who are building prototype applications and helping transform those prototypes into secure, scalable, production\-ready applications. The Software Engineer will be responsible for applying sound software engineering practices, implementing appropriate architecture and security controls, integrating enterprise data and systems, and ensuring applications can be hosted, supported, and operated appropriately within the enterprise. In many cases, the business will continue to own the application's features, functionality, and product direction after the prototype is converted. Application Development will partner closely with those business owners while maintaining responsibility for key technical areas such as **security, hosting, vulnerability management, and performance within the application and hosting layers under our control**. We are embracing an **AI\-first development approach**, and the successful candidate must be comfortable using AI\-powered development tools such as **Claude Code, Codex, and similar technologies** as a significant part of their day\-to\-day development workflow. This position requires strong technical skills, excellent communication, flexibility, and the ability to succeed in a fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities. This is a **full\-time, on\-site position**. **The Specifics of the Role** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support modern full\-stack applications. * Build front\-end applications using **React** and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks. * Develop APIs, services, and application back ends using **.NET / C\#**. * Design and work with relational databases such as **SQL Server and PostgreSQL**. * Develop and maintain integrations with internal and external enterprise systems. * Deploy and support applications and services within **Microsoft Azure**. * Partner directly with business users to understand workflows, requirements, and opportunities for automation. * Work closely with business users who create prototype applications and transform those prototypes into secure, reliable, production\-ready solutions. * Evaluate prototype applications and determine what should be retained, redesigned, or replaced before production deployment. * Apply enterprise standards for security, authentication, authorization, hosting, data access, and application architecture. * Help ensure applications meet organizational expectations for **security, vulnerability management, hosting, reliability, and performance within the application and hosting layers under our control**. * Partner with business owners who may continue to manage feature priorities, functionality, and application direction after production deployment. * Use AI development tools such as **Claude Code, Codex, and other coding assistants** extensively throughout the software development lifecycle. * Participate in architecture and design discussions and contribute to the continued evolution of development standards and reusable application patterns. * Troubleshoot application, integration, performance, and production issues. * Manage multiple applications, priorities, and development efforts in a fast\-moving environment. * Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Collaborate closely with other technology teams including Infrastructure, Security, Data, and Enterprise Architecture. **Requirements** **Required Qualifications** * Professional experience in **full\-stack software development**. * Experience with **C\# and .NET** development. * Experience designing, querying, and developing against relational databases such as **SQL Server or PostgreSQL**. * Experience building and consuming **REST APIs and system integrations**. * Understanding of modern application architecture and software engineering principles. * Strong understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, and secure development practices. * Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability and willingness to work directly with business users throughout the development process. * Strong interest in and willingness to use **AI\-assisted development tools as a primary part of the development workflow**. * Ability to work independently while also collaborating closely with a small development team. * Comfortable working in a **fast\-paced environment where priorities and requirements may evolve quickly**. * Willingness to learn new technologies, platforms, and development approaches. * Ability to work **on\-site full time**. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing applications in **Microsoft Azure**. * Experience with Azure services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, Service Bus, Key Vault, or similar services. * Experience with **Microsoft Entra ID**, OAuth, OpenID Connect, managed identities, or other modern authentication technologies. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and **GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps**. * Experience building event\-driven or integration\-heavy applications. * Experience working with enterprise systems and data platforms. * Experience modernizing prototypes, low\-code applications, or proof\-of\-concept solutions into enterprise\-grade software. **Some Things You Should Know** * No other builder can offer the collaborative design\-build approach that Clayco does. * We work on creative, complex, award\-winning, high\-profile jobs. * The pace is fast! **Why Clayco?** * 2025 Best Places to Work – St. Louis Business Journal, Los Angeles Business Journal, and Phoenix Business Journal. * 2025 ENR Top 400 – Top Data Center Contractor (Top 3\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Design\-Build Firms – Design\-Build Contractor (Top 5\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Green Contractors – Green Contractor (Top 3\). **Benefits** * Discretionary Annual Bonus: Subject to company and individual performance. * Comprehensive Benefits Package Including: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401k, generous PTO and paid company holidays, employee assistance program, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, learning \& development programs and more! **Compensation** * The salary range for this position considers a wide range of factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: Education, qualifications, skills, training, experience, certifications, internal equity, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for the role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The Clayco Nationwide salary range for this position is approximately $130,000 \- $160,000 \+/\- annually (not adjusted for location).

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: Clearwater Analytics is building its Generative AI engineering team, and this role sits at the center of that effort. You will design, implement, and ship LLM\-powered agent tools, MCP integrations, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems that are already in production use and you will do it using AI\-assisted development tools, including Claude Code, as a core part of your daily workflow. This is not exploratory AI work , it is applied engineering on real systems serving institutional investors globally. Fluency with coding assistants is not a perk here; it is a job requirement. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Build and maintain LLM agent pipelines, MCP integrations, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems using Python (FastAPI, LangChain) and TypeScript/React. * Use AI\-assisted development tools, including Claude Code, as a primary part of your engineering workflow for code generation, debugging, and iteration. * Collaborate with team members to optimize and improve existing AI\-powered software applications. * Participate actively in code reviews, giving and receiving clear, constructive feedback. * Perform root\-cause analyses for software issues and identify effective solutions. * Translate loosely defined requirements into functioning, production\-ready code. * Assist in the creation of user stories and estimation of work for project planning. * Suggest design improvements demonstrating a solid understanding of system architecture. * Ensure software applications are scalable, reliable, and secure. * Document software usage, implementation, architecture, design, and APIs. * Write broad unit and integration tests consistently. **Required Skills** ------------------- * Fluency with AI\-assisted development tools, Claude Code specifically ,as a daily engineering practice, not an occasional experiment. * Hands\-on experience building LLM agent tools, agentic workflows, MCP integrations, or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems in a production environment. * Production proficiency in Python 3\.11 (FastAPI, LangChain) and TypeScript/React , these are the core languages of this role. Java\-only backgrounds are not a fit. * Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design. * Enthusiasm for building in a fast\-moving, AI\-native SaaS environment. * Strong teamwork and communication skills , written and verbal. * Ability to manage own time and deliver results on time. * Commitment to continuous learning and improvement. * Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Strong attention to detail and documentation skills. **Education \& Experience** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. * 3\+ years of production software development experience * At least 1 year of hands\-on experience with LLM, agentic, or AI/ML systems in a production or near\-production environment. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive base salary and performance\-based bonus. * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits. * Flexible work arrangements, hybrid and remote options available. * Access to cutting\-edge AI tools and infrastructure as part of your day\-to\-day work. * A collaborative, high\-trust engineering culture that values craft, speed, and continuous learning. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ *Clearwater Analytics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Information** Clinical Ink is the global life science company that brings data, technology, and patient science together to unlock clinical discovery. Our deep therapeutic\-area expertise, coupled with Direct Data Capture, eCOA, eConsent, telehealth, neurocognitive testing, and digital biomarkers advancement, drive the industry standard for data precision and usher in a new generation of clinical trials. With offices in the United States and Denmark, Clinical Ink is rewriting the clinical development experience. **Job Description** Clinical Ink is seeking an ***AI Engineer*** **to join our Digital Health Technology (DHT) team** based in the United States. As an AI Engineer on the DHT team, you will be at the center of that lifecycle \- evaluating devices to ensure integration feasibility, then owning the production integration that ships it: mobile SDK and backend API integrations, device adaptors, ingestion pipelines, and the data model that takes it from prototype to a live, validated capability. You will also build the AI layer that makes each integration faster than the last, applying our AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI\-DLC) to study ready builds, automated validation, and agentic workflows \- equally comfortable writing the integration code yourself and building the tooling that accelerates the generation of integration patterns. The AI Engineer's responsibilities include but are not limited to: * Innovate Device Integration Patterns + Design and build end\-to\-end technical integrations for new connected devices — mobile SDK and vendor API integrations, device adaptors, ingestion pipelines, and the APIs that align device data to our platform data model. + Develop reusable, therapeutic\-area\-agnostic integration and event/alert patterns that replace one\-off, hardcoded builds and shorten time\-to\-integration for the next device. + Own technical design decisions under ISO 13485 design\-control principles, carrying integrations through implementation, testing, and release.Apply and extend our AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI\-DLC) to accelerate device integration, reference study builds, and automated validation, working closely with Engineering, Quality, Data, and Operations teams. * Cross\-Platform Data Pipelines + Build and maintain the data pipeline infrastructure that turns raw device streams into validated digital biomarkers, dashboards, and clinical endpoints. + Design pipeline patterns that generalize across our various platform environments and languages, rather than one\-off, environment\-specific solutions. + Integrate vendor SDKs and APIs to normalize and validate incoming data ahead of downstream analytics and reporting. * Collaborate across DHT Teams + Partner with Innovation, Product, Engineering, Data and Program leads through our DHT stage\-gate process to align team activities from evaluation to study\-ready. + Work with Quality and Regulatory teams to validate integrations against ISO 13485 and GxP requirements before release, and with Operations to ensure builds are ready for study configuration, logistics, and support. + Document evaluation methodology, reference architectures, and repeatable integration patterns so every device that follows ships faster than the one before it. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of software engineering experience shipping production systems (APIs, data pipelines, or platform integrations) and comfort owning integration work end\-to\-end, from technical evaluation through design, build, testing, and release. * Background in digital health, connected medical devices, clinical trials, or biomedical/health data preferred. * Understanding of medical device or regulated\-software quality practices (ISO 13485, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, or similar) or strong eagerness to learn our compliance model preferred. * Strong Python engineering skills, with the versatility to work across additional languages and platform stacks (i.e., JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, .NET/C\#) as integrations require. * Experience with containerization (Docker) and deploying on Kubernetes (Helm, EKS). * Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy). * Experience with CI/CD and GitOps\-based deployment (GitLab CI, ArgoCD). * Experience designing data models and working with cloud data infrastructure (AWS preferred), event\-driven (SQS, Kafka, Azure Event Hub) and batch\-based processing with idempotency and deduplication, and data warehouse integration. * Experience integrating mobile SDKs and vendor/device APIs into production applications (native iOS/Android or cross\-platform), including device pairing, Bluetooth, and REST/vendor device API connectivity patterns. * Hands\-on experience building or integrating LLM\-based or agentic systems (RAG, tool\-use/function calling, multi\-agent orchestration); familiarity with GraphRAG or knowledge\-graph patterns and AWS Bedrock/AgentCore is a plus. * Experience working with streaming or time\-series sensor/device data (value \+ timestamp patterns), including ingestion, normalization, and basic signal processing. **Additional Information** Clinical Ink is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against otherwise qualified applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability or handicap, or veteran status. Personal data submitted in connection with this position will be processed by Clinical Ink Denmark ApS and Clinical Ink, Inc. for recruitment and hiring purposes. Paycor Recruiting is used to collect and manage applications; please review the Clinical Ink Privacy Policy and Paycor Privacy Policy for additional information.

jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Clipboard** =================== Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app\-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S. Founded in 2016, we are a remote\-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y\-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022\. We’re the leader in Long\-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities. **Data Engineering** at Clipboard is deeply embedded in the business. Our exceptional engineers own the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation through deployment and ongoing support. Engineers at Clipboard have real autonomy over their work and are expected to take full ownership of what they build. For Data Engineering, that ownership means the pipelines, models, and tooling you build are load\-bearing for how operations, finance, product, and a growing set of AI\-assisted workflows make decisions every day. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team, which makes Clipboard's data and knowledge infrastructure reliable and well\-governed for everyone who makes decisions with it, human analysts and AI agents alike. You’ll build systems that make the data and definitions that matter most to the business easily accessible, like how we calculate net revenue, which shift statuses to commonly exclude, or what a "verified shift" means. All too often things like these live in people's heads, get rediscovered from scratch in every new analysis, and diverge across teams over time. You’ll develop workflows to enable capturing that meaning as governed, versioned artifacts (dbt semantic models, Snowflake views, structured knowledge files) so every customer can reuse it, regardless of whether that's a Hex project or a Claude agent. This increasingly means building for AI as a first\-class consumer. AI\-assisted analytics is only as good as the data and knowledge context quality underneath it, and you'll design and build the systems that close the knowledge loop: agentic workflows, peer\-reviewed artifact creation, and structured knowledge trees, so that running an analysis also improves the foundation for the next session. You'll also keep the foundations solid: the pipelines that extract, load, and transform data from source systems into the warehouse, where availability and freshness are prerequisites for everything else, and the access control framework (Snowflake roles, PII/PHI provisioning, least\-privilege at scale) that we own with our Security team for compliance requirements. As we increasingly invest into training and hosting production ML models, you’ll support the engineering teams’ needs to build, deploy, and monitor these systems. Our customers are our stakeholders, and we prioritize getting to the root cause of their problems and delivering systematic solutions. We measure ourselves by the reliability, adoption, quality, speed of the decisions our data enables. *Our data stack: Snowflake as the warehouse, dbt for transformation, Airbyte and Hevo for ingestion, Hex and Metabase for BI, and various agents (Claude, Codex, Snowflake Cortex, Hex AI, etc.) for AI\-assisted analysis. Source systems are largely MongoDB and Postgres.* **What we are looking for** --------------------------- We care more about how someone thinks through problems than how polished their narrative is. A successful Senior Data Engineer at Clipboard exhibits the following traits: * **First\-principles thinking:** you don't default to past experience. You dig into what's actually going on in a source system, a metric discrepancy, or a slow pipeline before deciding what to do. * **Customer\-centricity:** you stay close to your stakeholders, understand the decisions their data enables, and use that context to prioritize your focus on the right problems. * **Ownership and judgement:** you're comfortable owning infrastructure other people depend on. A pipeline that runs late or a metric that's slightly wrong breaks decisions downstream, and we want people who treat that responsibility like their own business. * **Technical strength:** the work spans pipelines, semantic modeling, governance, and AI\-facing knowledge infrastructure. jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: **Software Engineer II** Collective Data is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help shape our fleet, asset, and quartermaster management platform. Our applications are configuration\-driven: business objects, views, reports, and workflows are defined in metadata and run by a C\+\+/Qt server and an Angular web client. The role is hands\-on development across that stack, plus two areas of growing importance: building AI\-powered product features, and building the AI\-assisted development workflows our engineering team uses every day. The ideal candidate has strong product judgment and can look beneath the user experience to judge how software is built. They treat AI as both a product capability and an engineering tool. They understand how models behave, where they fail, and how to build systems that stay correct when they do. They remain accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of every change, regardless of who or what wrote it. **Key Responsibilities:** **Product Development and Judgement** * Turn customer workflows into intuitive, reliable functionality, finding requirement gaps and edge cases before development begins. * Balance immediate customer needs against product consistency and technical sustainability. * Own features from technical design through implementation, testing, release, and follow\-up. **Platform Development and Code Quality** * Develop and maintain functionality across the C\+\+/Qt server, the Angular web client, and the SQL layer that generates queries for PostgreSQL and SQL Server. * Extend the metadata\-driven application platform: the definition types, the engines that interpret them, and the authoring tools used to build applications on it. * Migrate legacy UI to Angular without changing its existing behavior. * Refactor incrementally to improve separation of responsibilities, error handling, and testability. * Do substantive code reviews covering correctness, design, performance, and security. **AI\-powered Product Features** * Design and build LLM\-backed features such as natural\-language querying, AI\-assisted record creation, and AI review of application definitions. * Design prompts and model context, define structured\-output contracts, and validate model responses before they affect customer data. * Build evaluation methods that catch answers that are wrong but look plausible, not only outright failures, and use them to tune prompts and instructions. * Choose and route between models based on cost, latency, and quality, and log AI interactions so problems can be diagnosed. * Design human review gates for AI\-proposed changes to customer data and configuration. **AI\-assisted Development Workflow** * Build and maintain the team's AI development tooling: agent skills, plugins, and automated workflows for starting work, implementation, self\-review, preparing PRs, and review retrospectives. * Build our architecture standards and code\-review lessons into that tooling so recurring mistakes are caught automatically. * Measure whether workflow changes actually improve quality and throughout and retire the ones that don't. * Critically evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, architectural fit, security, and maintainability. Verify it rather than accept it. * Follow company requirements for protecting source code, credentials, and customer information when using AI tools. **Technical Ownership and Reliability** * Independently investigate complex defects, including crashes, memory errors, and concurrency issues in the server, and find their root causes. * Assess the scope and risk of changes, including their effect on customer configurations and data. Design tests, data migrations, and rollback plans to match. * Enforce authorization and access\-control rules on the server and treat client\-supplied input as untrusted. * Fix performance problems across server logic, generated queries, and the UI. * Document significant design decisions and mentor other developers. **Required Qualifications:** * 6\+ years of professional software development, including ownership of production software and complex changes. * Strong C\+\+ skills: object\-oriented design, memory and resource management, debugging, and performance analysis. * Strong Angular and TypeScript skills, including RxJS and signals. * Strong SQL skills: relational modeling, query semantics and optimization, transactions, and schema changes. * Experience building configurable business software, where application behavior comes from metadata or configuration rather than code. * Experience shipping LLM\-powered features to production: prompt and context design, structured outputs and tool use, evaluation, and failure handling. * Deep hands\-on experience with agentic AI coding tools, including customizing them with skills, rules, or automated workflows, not just prompting them. * Working understanding of LLM limitations (context limits, nondeterminism, hallucination, prompt injection) and how to design around them. * Ability to understand an established codebase and tell sound design from fragile implementation. * Experience with code review, automated testing, version control, and production troubleshooting. * Clear communication of tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical colleagues. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Qt. * SQL Server in addition to PostgreSQL. * Building developer tooling or internal platforms used by other engineers. * Fleet, asset, maintenance, inventory, or quartermaster management systems. * Supporting government or other organizations with demanding reliability and security requirements. * Azure\-hosted applications and Azure DevOps. **What Success Looks Like:** * Product improvements are intuitive, consistent, and match how customers actually work. * Complex changes ship with appropriate testing and a clear understanding of their risks. * AI features either give correct answers or fail visibly. The rate of wrong\-but\-plausible answers is measured and going down. * The team's AI workflow catches problems before human review, and the same review comments stop recurring. * Code becomes easier to understand, maintain, and extend. * Other developers benefit from thoughtful reviews, clear guidance, and better tooling. **Who is Collective Data?** Collective Data is a leading provider of Fleet Management and Asset Management software for both the public and private sectors. Our mission is to empower organizations with intelligent software solutions that help streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency. **Why Join Us?** At Collective Data, we value innovation, collaboration, and the personal growth of our employees. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, flexible work arrangements, and an environment where your input is valued and encouraged. Interested in making a difference with Collective Data? Please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your relevant experience to careers@collectivedata.com *Collective Data is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.* Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * AD\&D insurance * Bereavement leave * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Flexible spending account * Free parking * Health insurance * Life insurance * On\-site gym * Paid parental leave * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance * Volunteer time off Application Question(s): * Are you willing and able to work in the office 5 days a week? * Explain how you’ve used AI assisted development in your day\-to\-day work. jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Storefront Services Team
jobs.description: **Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era** ======================================= At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI\-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce , Feedonomics , and Makeswift , we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever\-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you. We work as a distributed team across time zones, so we value clear writing and independence: thoughtful design docs, detailed pull requests, async discussions anyone can pick up, and the trust to move your work forward without waiting on others. We believe the people who build something are best placed to ship it, so our engineers take their own changes all the way to production and see them through with confidence. We are a team where you'll have real ownership, and where your work reaches shoppers on every BigCommerce storefront. BigCommerce, part of the Commerce brand family, helps merchants increase sales at every stage of their growth. From small startups to mid\-market businesses and large enterprises, we provide the leading e\-commerce platform. Our customers can then concentrate on what's most important: growing their businesses. We enable our customers to build, innovate, and grow, collectively reshaping the e\-commerce industry. **What You'll Do** * Build and maintain features in the service that powers every BigCommerce storefront, working with product managers and partner teams to shape the requirements and design the solution before building and releasing it * Add and extend GraphQL Storefront API queries and fields, following our schema guidelines so changes stay backward compatible for headless storefronts and third party integrations * Help evolve the storefront service to support AI driven shopping, so that agents and shopping assistants can browse, build carts, and check out for shoppers * Investigate and fix production issues, and improve performance and reliability in the areas of the service you work on Review code from teammates and the other engineering teams that contribute to the storefront service, and grow your design skills through design reviews and pairing with senior engineers * **Who Are You** * 3\+ years of experience building backend services that run in production * Education: Preferred minimum Bachelor's degree in CS, EE, SW, CE, MIS; or equivalent experience * Production experience with Scala or Kotlin preferred; backend engineers experienced in other languages (e.g., Java, Go, etc.) who are eager to learn Scala are encouraged to apply * Experience working with product managers or other stakeholders to turn requirements into a technical design, and delivering it to production * Working knowledge of HTTP fundamentals such as caching headers, cookies and sessions, and timeouts * Familiarity with GraphQL APIs * Familiarity with service to service communication and caching (e.g., gRPC, Redis, etc.) * Experience debugging production issues using metrics, traces, and logs (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Sentry, etc.) * Familiarity with releasing changes safely through feature flags and gradual rollouts * Experience writing automated tests and working with CI/CD pipelines * Uses AI coding assistants as a regular part of development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), and reviews AI generated code with the same care as code written by hand Interest in how AI agents use APIs (e.g., MCP, tool calling, etc.) * **Work Where You Thrive** For candidates based in the Austin or Atlanta metro area, the position follows a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office, balancing focused individual work with meaningful in\-person collaboration. \#LI\-HYBRID \#LI\-GC1 (Pay Transparency Range: $112,000\.00 – 168,000\.00 **Compensation Transparency** ============================= The national base salary range for this role is posted above in this job post. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications and geographic location. We also consider internal equity to help ensure fair and consistent pay practices across our teams. Where applicable, this role may also be eligible for variable compensation (such as bonus or commission), equity, and benefits in accordance with local policies. Details will be shared during the hiring process. We are committed to equitable and transparent pay practices that align to market data, internal equity, and individual contribution. **Inclusion and Belonging** =========================== At Commerce, we believe that celebrating the unique histories, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes a difference for our company, our customers and our community. We are an equal opportunity employer and the inclusive atmosphere we build together will make room for every person to contribute, grow and thrive. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. Learn more about the Commerce team, culture and benefits at https://www.commerce.com/careers/ **Identity Verification** ========================= To protect our candidates and company from fraudulent activity, our interview process includes a government ID and biometric verification via Persona, our trusted identity verification provider. All information is collected and processed securely in accordance with applicable privacy laws. **Protect Yourself Against Hiring Scams: Our Corporate Disclaimer** =================================================================== Commerce, along with many other employers, has become the subject of fraudulent job offers to hopeful prospective job seekers. Be advised: Commerce does not offer jobs to individuals who do not go through our formal hiring process. Commerce will never: * require payment of recruitment fees from candidates; * request personally identifiable information through unsanctioned websites or applications; * attempt to solicit money from you as part of the hiring process or as part of an employment offer; solicit money to complete visa requirements as part of a job offer. * If you receive unsolicited offers of employment from Commerce, we urge you to be extremely cautious and avoid engaging or responding.

jobs.title: Principal Mine Planning Engineer
jobs.description: **We invite you to Explore the Potential of being part of something Clearly Essential!** Compass Minerals (NYSE: CMP) is a leading global provider of essential minerals focused on safely delivering where and when it matters to help solve nature’s challenges for customers and communities. The company’s salt products help keep roadways safe during winter weather and are used in numerous other consumer, industrial, chemical and agricultural applications. Its plant nutrition products help improve the quality and yield of crops while supporting sustainable agriculture. Compass Minerals operates 11 production and packaging facilities with more than 1,800 employees throughout the U.S., Canada and the U.K. Visit compassminerals.com (https://www.compassminerals.com/) for more information about the company and its products. **Summary:** The Principal Mine Planning Engineer is the senior technical authority for underground mine planning, responsible for the integrity, optimization, and execution\-readiness of short\-term, mid‑range, and life‑of‑mine plans. This role provides strategic and operational leadership for a large underground mining operation, ensuring mine plans are safe, practical, compliant, and aligned with production, safety, and business objectives. The position leads multidisciplinary planning teams, integrates technical disciplines, and serves as the primary interface between strategic planning and day‑to‑day execution. **Essential Job Functions**: Included but not limited to the following: *(Management reserves the right to add or modify the duties and responsibilities at any time.)* * Serve as the senior technical authority for underground mine planning, providing independent expert judgment, technical direction, and assurance for short\-term, mid\-range, and life\-of\-mine plans. * Lead and mentor engineers, surveyors, technicians, interns, and technical contractors in the development and execution of mine plans and planning strategies. * Develop, optimize, and technically govern mine plans that integrate geology, geotechnical conditions, ventilation, utilities, equipment capabilities, and operational constraints. * Direct and technically govern mine design activities, including development layouts, sequencing, pillar design, and supporting infrastructure. * Provide technical oversight of underground utilities and systems—including ventilation, atmospheric monitoring, power, water, compressed air, and communications—to ensure regulatory compliance, safety, and execution feasibility. * Convert strategic and long\-range mine plans into actionable, clearly sequenced execution plans that operations can reliably implement. * Serve as the primary interface between mine planning and execution, ensuring plans are clearly communicated, understood, and executable by operations and frontline leadership. * Facilitate technical syndication of mine plans across operations, maintenance, safety, leadership, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment, feasibility, and shared ownership. * Facilitate and participate in technical reviews, planning forums, and execution\-readiness discussions to proactively identify risks, conflicts, and constraints prior to implementation. * Apply advanced analytics, scenario modeling, and trade\-off studies to optimize mine design, sequencing, production rates, recovery and capital efficiency. * Support ground control inspection, monitoring, and risk mitigation programs in collaboration with geotechnical teams. * Support exploration programs, including drilling, seismic activities, and geologic modeling; contribute to mineral resource and reserve estimation and validation. * Assess plan performance through reconciliation and variance analysis; integrate lessons learned and operational feedback into continuous plan improvement. * Create and sustain high\-quality planning deliverables, including schedules, layouts, models, and technical documentation that clearly articulate design intent and assumptions. * Guide production scheduling and mine services planning while driving continuous improvement in planning processes. * Identify, assess, and escalate planning\-driven risks and constraints that may impact safety, production, schedule, or capital outcomes; lead mitigation planning in collaboration with stakeholders. * Lead or contribute to capital projects related to underground development and infrastructure upgrades. * Act as a key contributor to annual budgeting, forecasting, long\-range capital planning, and resource and reserve reporting. * Enforce compliance with safety standards, regulatory requirements, and company engineering practices while optimizing operational and economic outcomes. **Minimum Required Qualifications:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Mining Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Geology, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * 10 years of progressive experience in underground mining operations with increasing technical responsibility. * Demonstrated expertise in short\-term, mid\-range, and life\-of\-mine planning for underground operations. * Demonstrated advanced proficiency in mine planning tools and methodologies, with emphasis on planning quality and design support rather than software operation alone. * Proficiency in mine planning, surveying, AutoCAD, ventilation modeling, and related software (e.g., Deswik, Maptek, Leica Geosystems, GPS, VnetPC, Ventsim, and AggFlow). * Strong data literacy; experience querying databases and building dashboards and analytics in Power BI. **Preferred:** * Professional Engineer (PE) license. * Experience managing and/or mentoring technical teams. * Experience managing a salaried and hourly workforce. * Experience working in unionized environments. **Physical Requirements:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Ability to walk up to 2 miles over uneven underground and surface terrain. * Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE). * Ability to stoop, kneel, crouch, climb ladders, and crawl in confined or restricted spaces. * Ability to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds routinely and up to 50 pounds occasionally. * Vision abilities include close vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. * Periodic work in hoists, shafts, and underground mine environments involving close‑quarters conditions, limited clearance, vertical access, and exposure to hot, humid, dusty, and noisy conditions. * Perform indoor and outdoor work in adverse weather conditions. Compass Minerals is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are firmly committed to making all employment\-related decisions without regard to race, ancestry, ethnicity, color, religious creed or belief, national origin, sex (including sexual orientation, gender identity, and pregnancy and breastfeeding), age, military or veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, genetic information, and any other characteristic protected by law. Learn more about equal employment opportunity laws at dol.gov (https://www.dol.gov/agencies/ofccp/posters). April 2026 Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner (6 Month Contract Role)
jobs.description: **About CompassX:** CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high\-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data\-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants. We are honored to be recognized as a three\-time winner of *Consulting Magazine’s* Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest\-growing private companies in the U.S. ### **Role Description:** We’re looking for a **Technical Product Owner** to get the most value out of the internal developer platforms behind a global quick service restaurant brand’s digital operations. You’ll sit within the brand’s Solutions Architecture team. Your job is to turn what engineering teams need into a clear, prioritized backlog across CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, observability, developer tooling, and systems integration that supports restaurant\-facing ordering systems. This role suits someone who treats engineers as customers, likes working closely with platform, SRE, and DevOps teams, and wants to improve developer experience through self\-service and automation. You’ll make sure platform capabilities get adopted, are easy to use, and match both business and engineering priorities. ### **What You'll Do:** * Contribute to the product roadmap for internal developer platforms, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure, observability, and automation tooling. * Own and manage the product backlog, translating engineering needs into clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria so work is consistently ready for development. * Gather and represent feedback from engineering teams through interviews, surveys, office hours, and ongoing engagement. * Partner closely with SRE, DevOps, and Solutions Architecture teams to balance product priorities with technical execution. * Collaborate across brand product teams, platform engineering, and enterprise cloud and security teams to align on priorities and dependencies. * Drive adoption of platform capabilities through customer\-focused prioritization and clear communication of what’s being built, what isn’t, and why. * Contribute to self\-service and automation initiatives that cut manual support work and make developers more productive. * Track and report product metrics such as adoption, user satisfaction, operational efficiency, and productivity, and use them to guide decisions. * Support planning, intake, and capacity management for platform initiatives. ### **What You'll Bring:** * **3\+ years of experience** working on technical products for technical users such as engineers, developers, or IT teams, including **1–2\+ years** in product management or technical product ownership. * Experience owning and managing a product backlog in an Agile environment. * Experience with user research and requirements gathering, and with turning user needs into well\-defined product deliverables. * Familiarity with product metrics and with measuring adoption and outcomes. * Working knowledge of CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE concepts. Experience with developer tools, internal platforms, or infrastructure products is a strong plus. * A service mindset: you hold a high bar for your internal customers’ experience and earn trust through consistent delivery and clear communication. * Ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. You define what success looks like and follow through. * Bachelor’s degree in any field (technical degree preferred). ### **Nice to Have:** * Hands\-on technical background or prior experience working closely with engineers. * Exposure to automation, self\-service platforms, or workflow tooling. * Experience in a consumer\-scale digital environment such as quick service restaurants, retail, or other high\-transaction systems. * Familiarity with restaurant technology or POS (point of sale) systems. * Product management certifications or formal product training. $50 \- $65 an hour We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Technical Product Owner **Location:** Remote **Job Type:** Full\-Time **About Us** Computer Information Systems, Inc. (CIS) is a nationwide leader in Public Safety Software, supporting Federal, State, County, and Municipal agencies. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do. We provide a positive, team\-oriented work culture, and offer outstanding benefits including employer\-paid medical, dental, life, and short\-term disability insurance. **Position Overview** CIS builds full suite CAD, RMS, and JMS software for public safety agencies, including mobile field applications for officers. The Technical Product Owner drives one product area from idea to release. This person writes the specifications, guides the design, and owns product decisions for our field mobile applications. **Key Responsibilities** ***Product Strategy \& Vision*** · Partner with stakeholders to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap. · Write detailed specifications and clear, testable acceptance criteria for each feature. · Set the order of backlog work by user value, business impact, and technical feasibility. ***Design \& Delivery*** · Use rapid prototypes tools to clarify UI concepts and verify with customers and SMEs. · Apply AI\-driven design tools to speed up ideation and layout work. · Own product requirements for our mobile field applications, for iOS, Android, or both. · Establish and maintain design standards so the product stays consistent. · Lead backlog refinement and the sprint plan meeting. Agree the sprint goal with the team. · Accept or reject each completed story against its acceptance criteria. ***Technical \& Cross\-Functional Leadership*** · Work with engineers on architecture trade\-offs. Record each decision and its reason. · Lead and align blended teams, including onshore and offshore engineers. · Use AI tools each week to speed up research, specification drafts, and data analysis. · Find where AI features give value in the product, and write the requirements for them. ***Research, Risk \& Performance*** · Conduct user research and usability testing. Use the results to improve the product. · Lead customer interviews and discovery sessions to identify key problems, workflows and use cases. · Identify risks early and apply a clear plan to reduce each risk. · Track product KPIs and engagement metrics. Report status to stakeholders in plain language. **Minimum Qualifications** · 8 or more years as a Product Owner, UX/Product Designer, or a similar role with direct design work. · Experience with mobile application development, or direct product ownership of a mobile application. · Advanced skill with AI design tools for UI design and prototyping. · Practical AI skill. You use AI tools each week for design, research, or specification work. · Hands\-on experience with Agile frameworks and backlog management. · Ability to lead and align teams across time zones, including onshore and offshore engineers. · Proven ability to write PRDS and specifications that engineers can build from without more questions. · Excellent written and verbal communication with engineering, QA, and business stakeholders. · Strong understanding of user experience principles and human\-centered design. · Must pass a criminal background check. **Preferred Qualifications** · Knowledge of front\-end technologies and mobile development processes. · Experience with public safety software, for example CAD, RMS, or field applications for officers. · Previous experience that took a new product to market. · Familiarity with generative AI platforms, for example GPT\-based design assistants. · Experience with SQL or another tool for your own data analysis. **Benefits** · Employer\-paid medical, dental, life, and short\-term disability insurance · Vision insurance · 401(k) retirement plan · Paid time off · Parental leave **Schedule** · Full\-time, 40 hours per week. · Standard business hours, Monday through Friday. · Remote work location. Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Are you able to pass a thorough criminal background check? Experience: * Product Owner, UX/Product Designer, or similar direct design : 8 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **As our Sr. Backend Engineer, you’ll help drive Concora Credit’s Mission to enable customers to Do More with Credit – every single day.** **The impact you’ll have at Concora Credit:** Join us in shaping a seamless, best\-in\-class credit origination experience for consumers applying for our products. As part of an agile team, you’ll help deliver web and mobile solutions that meet the highest standards for quality, performance, security, and reliability. Your focus will be on evolving the underlying originations platform. We hire people, not positions. That's because, at Concora Credit, we put people first, including our customers, partners, and Team Members. Concora Credit is guided by a single purpose: to help non\-prime customers *do more* with credit. Today, we have helped millions of customers access credit. Our industry leadership, resilience, and willingness to adapt ensure we can help our partners responsibly say yes to millions more. As a company grounded in entrepreneurship, we're looking to expand our team and are looking for people who foster innovation, strive to make an impact, and want to Do More! We’re an established company with over 20 years of experience, but now we’re taking things to the next level. We're seeking someone who wants to impact the business and play a pivotal role in leading the charge for change. **As our Sr. Backend Engineer, you will:** * Deliver high\-quality, secure, efficient, scalable, and reusable code that always protects customer privacy and confidentiality. * Be a leader, taking the initiative to identify gaps, propose solutions, and embrace ownership of both personal work and team solutions. * Contribute across the full stack – backend, API layer, and frontend, collaborating positively and effectively across teams. * Have a strong focus on quality, reliability, robust operations, and performance. * Develop and support 3rd party integrations, frontend capabilities, and internal partner interfaces. * Conduct code reviews, testing, and optimization to ensure the performance, security, and completeness of our solutions. * Partner with architects and team members to drive technical decisions and provide input on our architecture, data modeling, and APIs. * Extend existing system functionality based on user requirements; analyze code to identify areas for modification and maintain and support existing products. * Test, evaluate, and recommend technologies to improve our overall solutions. * Leverage AI tools to gain efficiency in all areas of SW development * Consult with product managers and business analysts to define, scope, and plan new features. * Partner with teammates, Product, and upstream/downstream teams to ensure solutions are delivered on time and fully meet requirements. * Be a key participant in our agile development framework. * Produce complete and coherent documentation. * Support and participate in on\-call rotations. **These duties must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.** We know experience comes in many forms and that many skills are transferable. jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **About us** ============ Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI\-first e\-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e\-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. **About the team** ================== The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse \& recommendations) \& executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents. Our team owns both platform \& product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery\-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services. All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down. The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on\-call. **About you** ============= You're a staff\-level engineer who wants to own systems, not tickets. You've built high\-traffic, low\-latency Python services and carried the pager for them. You think in trade\-offs: latency versus cost, flexibility versus a public API that customers can't afford to see break, the fix that ships this week versus the architecture that has to last two years. You can lead work that spans several engineers and several quarters, you enjoy mentoring others, and you're fine when a problem shows up half\-defined. You don't mind being the one who reads the spec for some unfamiliar protocol, works out how it fits, and designs an integration that holds up at scale. You change your mind when someone has a better argument, you make the people around you better, and you still care about your code long after it merges. **What you will do** ==================== * Own the technical direction of one or more of our services \- architecture, performance, and reliability. * Lead design of new systems and public APIs, and the evolution of existing ones as traffic and feature scope grow. * Raise the engineering bar through design and code review, and mentor mid and senior engineers into owning bigger scopes. * Partner with product, other engineering teams, and solutions/support to shape what we build and to represent search constraints and trade\-offs honestly. * Take part in on\-call for the systems you own, and lead incident response and follow\-through when things break. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- ### **Technical** * Substantial experience building and operating high\-traffic, low\-latency backend services in production. * Extensive Python knowledge (our primary language). * Experience with observability and performance work in live systems. * Experience designing and evolving public APIs that external customers depend on. * Experience designing \& implementing scalable service\-oriented architectures. ### **Beyond the code** * Track record of leading projects that span multiple engineers and quarters. * Influence without authority, and willingness to change your position when someone has a better argument. * Clear written communication \- design docs, RFCs, postmortems. * Good judgment about trade\-offs and scope. * Comfort with ambiguity and loosely defined problems. * Ownership that extends past merge, to how the system behaves in production. ### **Nice to have** * Experience with AWS * Background in search, ranking, information retrieval, or e\-commerce product discovery. * Exposure to AI/LLM\-facing infrastructure (MCP, agent tooling, or similar). **Benefits** ============ ️ Unlimited vacation time \- we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year Fully remote team \- choose where you live ️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office Apple laptops provided for new employees ‍ Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year Maternity \& Paternity leave for qualified employees Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact Base salary: $110k–$130k USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results Stock options \- offered in addition to the base salary Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor** =================================================== At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group. jobs.title: Senior | Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description: Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality\-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team. **Senior \| Staff Product Engineer** Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) is hiring **Senior** and **Staff Product Engineers** to join our Technology team. In these hands\-on, full\-stack roles, you'll work across our brand portfolio to design, build, and modernize our tech stack—from client\-facing digital experiences to the internal operating system that runs our business. We have openings at both levels and will align the title and scope to your experience. You'll join a small, sharp team that solves real business problems with whatever works best, whether that's AI, custom code, or intelligently integrated enterprise systems. You'll write code, design solutions, and contribute to the culture we're building at CHG. Though early in adopting AI\-driven development, we're building an AI\-first engineering team and want engineers who will help us get there. Day to day, that means paying attention to how we work, spotting technical gaps, and helping us iterate our way into the future. You'll help shape the tech and practices that we carry forward. **What You'll Do:** * **Build end to end.** Own features across the front end, back end, APIs, business logic, and data layer. You'll take them from ideation to production and beyond: measuring, learning, and continuously improving. * **Connect the dots.** A lot of the pieces are already there. Design how our systems fit together across brands, apps, and enterprise tools like Salesforce and NetSuite. Build the integrations that keep them talking, and handle client, employee, and financial data with security, privacy, and compliance in mind. * **Turn problems into plans.** Break ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans and reviewable units of work for humans and agents. * **Work AI\-native.** Use AI agents across research, prototyping, implementation, testing, refactoring, and documentation, and verify what they produce. * **Shape the foundation.** Contribute to architecture, technology choices, and development patterns built to scale with the business. * **Help set the standard.** Introduce and refine AI development practices, tools, and workflows, and help teammates adopt them. * **Wilderness coding.** Leave it better than you found it. Make the codebase easier to work in, for people and agents alike. That means tests, monitoring, documentation, and architecture patterns that scale with the business. * **Collaborate.** Partner with product, design partners, and engineering to clarify requirements and explain trade\-offs. Participate in code review, pairing, onboarding, and mentorship. **What We Look For:** * You have 6\+ years of experience engineering production software for Senior level, or 9\+ years with cross\-system architecture ownership for Staff level. * You're solid on relational data, including SQL, schema design, transactions, and migrations, and comfortable with modern data platforms: warehouses, pipelines, and getting the right data to the right place. * You build with quality and security in mind. That includes testing, accessibility, input validation, authentication and authorization, and common web security risks. * You use AI agents for real multi\-step work, not just autocomplete. You write clear specs, scope tasks well, give agents the right context, and check what they produce against the real system. Maybe you've even said out loud, "I hardly even touch the actual code anymore." * You think like a product engineer. You start with the problem, not the solution, ask "why" before "how," and get creative about solving it. * You make thoughtful technical judgments that hold up over time, even while treading in murky waters. You have a bias toward simple, maintainable solutions. KISS or bust. * You like thinking out loud. You bring ideas to technical planning, welcome pushback on yours, and give honest, kind feedback in return. * You explain decisions, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to engineers and non\-engineers. You make teammates better through code review, pairing, and mentoring. * You've led technical work beyond your own tickets: scoping projects, guiding other engineers, and working with external partners or contractors to keep delivery on track and quality high. At the Staff level, you've owned architecture across multiple systems. * You're curious. You keep up with fast\-changing tools and practices, evaluate them on evidence, and know what to bring in and what to admire from afar, based on what we can sustain long\-term. **Bonus Points:** * You've shipped an LLM\-backed feature to production and trudged through the task of programmatically determining whether it's doing its job. * You've extended an AI development environment with MCP servers, repository instructions, reusable skills, custom workflows, or automated code review. * You've worked with business systems like Salesforce, NetSuite, or HRIS platforms. * You've built event\-driven systems or reverse ETL pipelines. * You've worked with AWS or a similar cloud platform, and with infrastructure as code. * You've established new systems, standards, or engineering practices from an early stage. * You've worked in hospitality, events, real estate, or another customer\-centric, multi\-location business. **Compensation:** The above job definition information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Job duties and responsibilities are subject to change based on changing business needs and conditions. Base Salary: Salary Min: $150,000 Salary Max: $200,000 This role is also eligible for Convene's annual incentive performance bonus plan. This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors. **We're Here For You:** At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here's what you can expect: * **Health \& Wellness:** Day\-one health coverage for you and your family, 24/7 virtual care, emotional well\-being support, and fertility \& family planning benefits. Because your well\-being matters, inside and outside of work. * **Time Off \& Balance:** Generous PTO, your birthday off (because, of course!), paid parental leave, and a year\-end holiday closure to recharge. * **Financial Growth:** 401K with company match and support for education, courses, and certifications. We invest in you so you can grow personally and professionally. * **Development \& Recognition:** Ongoing career growth opportunities plus recognition programs to celebrate milestones. * **Community \& Impact:** Volunteer and give\-back opportunities, and the chance to make a real impact in the work you do. At Convene Hospitality Group, we believe great teams are built by bringing together people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Our values of GRIT (Genuine, Relentless, Integrity, and Teamwork) shape how we show up for each other every day. We want everyone here to feel welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. If you're excited to grow, learn, and make an impact, we'd love to have you on the team. Convene Hospitality Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. \#LI\-DK1

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About Corridor** ------------------ Corridor is the first AI\-native employee benefits brokerage. We use AI agents to take on some of the hardest problems in healthcare for the people we serve. It’s a true AI\-native services business, backed by blue\-chip venture funds. Our mission is to make health insurance and benefits actually work for the people who deal with them \- the people who place coverage and the employees who live with it. It’s one of the biggest and most poorly served markets in the country, and the tools haven’t really changed in decades. Our team is small and really strong, and our agents already do real work every day. What we need now is someone who makes that work feel easy for the people on the other side of it. **The role** ------------ This is a senior role at the tech lead level. You’ll own the agent experience end to end \- data model, APIs, and UI \- and you’ll be the voice of the user on our engineering team. That means spending real time with advisors and clients, setting the bar for what good looks like, and holding us to it. We’re not aiming for “it works.” We’re aiming for “people love using it.” **What you’ll build** --------------------- **The advisor console.** Each of our advisors works with a lot of small businesses, with a team of agents behind them. You’ll build the place where they see what actually needs their attention, act on it, and hand work back and forth with agents. We want it to be the best agent orchestration tool out there, in any industry. **A benefits advisor for every small business.** The tools small businesses use to work with us, from getting quotes to picking plans to getting set up. It should feel like having a great benefits advisor on call, without the paperwork. **The employee experience.** ID cards, enrollment, changes during the year, and straight answers about coverage, for people who’ve never had a benefits advisor before. **The APIs and data models underneath.** The services that connect all of this to our agents, carrier data, and operations. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- **Senior, by level and experience.** 5\+ years shipping production web products. You’ve led projects and made the engineers around you better. **Full stack reach.** You’ve built polished, complex interfaces in React and TypeScript, and you’re just as comfortable with the API, schema, and Python services behind them. **A high bar for experience.** You know the difference between software that does the job and software people love, and you won’t settle for the first. You have real opinions on what good UX looks like when agents are doing a lot of the work. **User empathy.** You like sitting with the people who use what you build, seeing where they get stuck, and fixing it. You’d rather watch an advisor use your feature than read a ticket about it. **Ownership of outcomes.** You take a fuzzy problem from the first conversation to shipped, then check whether it actually moved the needle. You measure yourself on results, not hours or tickets closed. **Comfort building with AI.** You’ve built on LLMs, or you really want to. You understand how agents fail and how to design around that so a person stays in the loop when it matters. **Mission and impact.** You want your work to make health insurance better for real people, not just to be technically interesting.
