jobs.title: Talent Sourcer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- Garver is seeking a **Talent Sourcer** to identify, engage, and develop relationships with engineering, technical, and professional talent across our business. The Talent Sourcer will become a trusted research and pipeline partner to Garver’s Talent Acquisition team. The right person will understand how to translate a business need into a sourcing plan, find qualified professionals in specialized markets, and create credible reasons for passive candidates to engage. The Talent Sourcer will serve as a subject matter expert on the civil engineering talent market by conducting ongoing market research and providing insights on talent availability, compensation trends, competitor hiring activity, geographic workforce dynamics, and emerging technical skill demands to support both current and future hiring strategies. This is not a resume\-search\-only role. The role will support searches across Garver’s engineering and professional services environment, which may include Aviation, Buildings, Federal, Field Services, Transportation, Water, Environmental, Structural, MEP, and corporate disciplines. Success requires curiosity, follow\-through, sound judgment, and the ability to learn technical career paths quickly. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- **Develop focused talent pipelines** * Partner with recruiters and hiring leaders to clarify the target profile, business need, geography, experience level, and search priorities. * Identify and engage passive and active candidates for engineering, technical, and professional positions. * Build reusable pipelines for current openings, anticipated needs, strategic locations, and difficult\-to\-fill disciplines. * Balance pipeline volume with candidate quality, relevance, and readiness for recruiter review. **Research beyond the obvious channels** * Use LinkedIn and a broader mix of sources, including professional associations, licensing databases, conference and event information, referrals, university networks, niche job boards, portfolio sites, company research, and public professional information. * Create talent maps that show relevant employers, locations, titles, career paths, available talent, and potential recruiting constraints. * Track competitor and labor\-market signals that may affect search strategy, candidate availability, or outreach positioning. * Test new research methods and document repeatable sourcing approaches for the Talent Acquisition team. **Create candidate interest** * Write concise, personalized outreach grounded in a candidate’s visible experience and the reason a conversation may be relevant. * Build professional relationships with passive talent and maintain appropriate follow\-up over time. * Represent Garver accurately and credibly, without overpromising a role, title, location, compensation, or career outcome. * Share qualified, well\-documented prospects with recruiters, including the evidence supporting the match and the questions that still need to be validated. **Turn sourcing activity into usable intelligence** * Maintain accurate pipeline records, notes, contact history, and disposition information in the appropriate systems. * Monitor activity and outcomes such as prospects identified, outreach, responses, recruiter review, screens, and pipeline movement. * Use results to recommend changes to target profiles, search locations, outreach angles, and sourcing channels. * Provide practical market feedback to recruiters and hiring leaders when the available talent does not match the original search assumptions. **Supervisory Responsibilities** -------------------------------- * No supervisory responsibilities **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 2\+ years talent sourcing, recruiting, talent research, executive search, market intelligence, or a related research\-intensive role. * Demonstrated ability to find qualified people through multiple research methods, not solely through keyword searches or inbound applications. * Strong written communication and the judgment to tailor outreach to technical and professional audiences. * Ability to evaluate career history, titles, employers, projects, credentials, geography, and progression to determine whether a conversation is warranted. * Organization and persistence to manage multiple searches, document work accurately, and follow through on agreed priorities. * Comfort partnering with recruiters and hiring leaders, receiving feedback, and adjusting search strategy quickly. * Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and common recruiting, research, CRM, or applicant\-tracking tools. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience sourcing engineers, architects, construction professionals, environmental professionals, or other specialized technical talent. * Knowledge of engineering consulting, infrastructure, architecture, construction, MEP, or adjacent professional services markets. * Experience with talent mapping, competitive intelligence, Boolean search, data enrichment, licensing research, or structured pipeline reporting. * Experience supporting multi\-state or geographically dispersed recruiting teams. * A track record of converting research and outreach into qualified recruiter conversations, not simply large prospect lists. **K****nowledge and Skills** ---------------------------- * Proficient Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word, and Excel * Attention to detail in composing, typing, and proofing materials, establishing priorities, and meeting deadlines. * Strong interpersonal and communication skills to work with candidates and internal clients across Garver. * Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality. **Working Conditions and Physical Requirements** ------------------------------------------------ Work is generally performed in an office environment. Occasional travel to off\-site locations may be required to perform work\-related duties and attend meetings. Physical demands include the ability to hear, understand, and distinguish speech to communicate effectively with employees, clients, and stakeholders in person, by telephone, and through virtual communication platforms. The position requires sufficient visual acuity to read printed materials and computer screens and the ability to operate a computer, keyboard, and other standard office equipment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Position Type, Expected Hours of Work and FLSA Considerations** ----------------------------------------------------------------- This is a full\-time position with a standard work schedule of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., unless otherwise approved by management. **Location and Telecommuting** ------------------------------ This is an in\-office position for any Garver office location. **Grow With Us** Garver offers its employees programs such as company\-paid professional memberships, company support for industry licenses and continuing education opportunities that foster a progressive atmosphere. Garver provides the tools, resources, and environment to develop leaders, stimulate ideas, and accomplish projects. By offering highly competitive salary packages, attractive benefits, and a comprehensive wellness program; Garver walks the talk when it comes to work\-life balance. Founded in 1919, Garver is an employee\-owned engineering, planning, and environmental services firm focused on aviation, transportation, buildings, federal, water and wastewater services; surveying; advisory services; and construction engineering and inspection. In the top 100 of Engineering News\-Record’s Top 500 Design Firms list, with more than 1,500 employees, Garver provides an exceptional level of client service that reflects our people\-first culture, which has achieved Zweig Group Best Firm to Work For Legacy Status. Learn how Garver invests in people and places they call home at GarverUSA.com.

jobs.title: Power Platform Administrator
jobs.description: Are you passionate about empowering teams with low\-code solutions and AI\-assisted tools in a safe and secure environment? As a Power Platform Administrator at Gas South, you will play a pivotal role on our Infrastructure team by managing and optimizing our Microsoft Power Platform environment and Microsoft 365 Copilot services. In this position, you will administer and monitor Power Platform applications (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents) and emerging AI features like Copilot Studio/Agent 365, ensuring they operate smoothly, securely, and in alignment with enterprise policies. You will work closely with Security, IT Service Operations, and Leadership teams to implement standards, and with internal developers and business users to support innovation. We are seeking candidates who are detail\-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, with a strong commitment to operational excellence. The ideal candidate has a blend of technical acumen in cloud platform administration and a service\-oriented mindset, ready to help Gas South leverage next\-generation tools safely and effectively. Are You a Fit? ### **Additional Responsibilities** * Administer the Power Platform Ecosystem: Oversee all Power Platform environments (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI integration) including environment provisioning, configuration, and maintenance. Manage tenant settings (e.g., data integration, capacity quotas, updates) to ensure platform health and performance. * Microsoft 365 Copilot Administration: Serve as the administrator for Microsoft 365 Copilot (Copilot and Agent in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center) and Copilot Studio (Power Platform Admin Center) within the organization. Configure and manage Copilot features and settings according to business needs and policy (enabling/disabling capabilities, managing authorized user access). Approve and operationalize Copilot agents created by business units, ensuring they meet security and compliance requirements before deployment. Manage and reduce Agent Sprawl across the environment. * Platform Support \& Troubleshooting: Act as a Tier\-III support resource for issues related to Power Platform applications and Copilot usage. Work with internal developers and "citizen developers" to resolve complex platform problems, performing root\-cause analysis and engaging Microsoft support if needed. * Application Lifecycle Management (ALM): Coordinate solution deployment and upgrades across development, test, and production environments. Manage Power Platform application lifecycle processes (e.g., solution import/export, version control) to support safe and controlled rollout of new apps, flows, and AI agents. * User Enablement \& Best Practices: Collaborate with development teams and business stakeholders to promote best practices in building low\-code solutions and integrating Copilot features. Provide guidance or small\-scale assistance (e.g., templates, example solutions) to help teams accelerate projects while following governance guidelines. * Monitoring \& Optimization: Utilize admin center tools and analytics to track platform utilization, performance metrics, and licensing. Report trends and propose optimizations (e.g., adjusting capacity, consolidating resources) to enhance efficiency and user experience. * Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain documentation for platform configurations, administrative procedures, and usage guidelines. Contribute to the internal knowledge base and runbooks for Power Platform and Copilot administration. * Cross\-Team Collaboration: Work closely with Identity and Access Management (Entra ID/Azure AD) administrators to ensure seamless integration of user provisioning and access controls. Partner with other members of the Infrastructure and Security teams to align platform settings with overall IT policies (such as data retention, incident response, and change management). Engage in regular change control processes for platform updates and communicate effectively with IT and business teams about any impacts. ### **Experience** * 5\+ years of IT experience, with at least 2\-3 years focused on administering or supporting Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, etc.) in an enterprise environment. * Microsoft Fundamental certification(s) for Power Platforms and Copilot/Agent administration, such as the PL\-900 (Power Platform Fundamentals) and the AB\-900 (Copilot and Agent Administration). * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft 365 Administration, including familiarity with Teams, SharePoint, or Exchange Online, and an understanding of how these services integrate with Power Platform and Copilot. * Strong knowledge of Azure AD (Entra ID) for managing users, groups, and application permissions, especially as it relates to Power Platform and Microsoft 365 services. * Proven ability to implement and enforce policies in technical platforms, working within frameworks established by security team and the business. * Exp AI\-900/901 (Azure AI Fundamentals), AB\-620 (AI Agent Builder Associate), and or AI\-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate). * ITIL Foundation certification or knowledge of IT Service Management best practices, indicating experience with structured change, incident, and problem management processes. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI technologies in a business context (e.g., previous involvement in deploying AI\-driven solutions or virtual assistants) is a strong plus. * Experience collaborating on low\-code Center of Excellence (CoE) initiatives or contributing to governance boards for new technology rollouts. * Exposure to PowerShell scripting or automation tools for administrative task automation within Microsoft 365 or Azure environments. * Continuous learning mindset, with a track record of staying updated on new Microsoft cloud features, security updates, and best practices. ### **Location Requirements** Atlanta, GA or Gainesville, FL (with flexibility for hybrid work arrangements as appropriate) ### **Physical Requirements** * Ability to sit for extended periods at a desk or workstation, performing computer\-based tasks and collaborating with team members via meetings or calls. * Ability to operate standard office IT equipment, including computers, keyboards, and conferencing tools, for prolonged periods. * Occasional requirement to connect or configure hardware (such as networking gear or peripheral devices) which may involve stooping, kneeling, or reaching. * Ability to travel to Gas South offices or data centers on occasion if necessary. * General ability to work in typical office conditions, including sustaining visual focus on screens and managing standard office environmental factors (lighting, climate control, etc.). *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* **Our Purpose and Culture** At Gas South, we approach each day knowing we have an opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. That means helping our customers save money with everyday low rates and treating them with dignity, honesty and respect. It means supporting our employees in their personal and professional lives, and it means we want to make sure our success directly benefits the communities we serve by giving back 5% of profits to support children in need. Through partnerships with non\-profits like United Way, Salvation Army, Junior Achievement, Bert's Big Adventure and many others, we're proud to help make a difference. At Gas South our employees bring their boldest ideas and most authentic selves to work, no matter their title, position or background. We understand that our people are our most valuable assets. So, we treat them that way, with competitive benefits, flexible schedule options, and a fun, casual atmosphere. Gas South affirms that it is an Equal Opportunity Employer whose actions and practices are consistent with fair employment. In this regard, Gas South will not discriminate against any employee or applicant with regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment including recruiting, hiring, placement, training, promotion, lay\-offs, transfers, leave of absence, compensation and termination. **Benefits for full\-time employees include:** * Full medical, dental, and vision coverage * Employer\-paid life and disability coverage * Annual employer contributions of up to 12\.5% to your 401k * Remote work options available based on business needs * Annual performance incentive is a % of annual benchmark based on position level * Paid four\-week sabbatical every five years * Opportunities to volunteer in the community * Education assistance up to $5250 per year

People leadership or strong informal team leadership experience is preferred. **Skills:** * Write production\-quality code in Scala and/or Python, with working comfort in Node.js/TypeScript for SDKs and tooling. * Bring deep REST/JSON API expertise, including authentication, idempotency, schema evolution, versioning, monitoring, and incident response. * Have a track record of building reusable architecture, tooling, or playbooks that scaled a team’s output without proportional headcount growth. * Use AI\-native workflows and tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot as first\-class accelerants, while knowing when deterministic approaches are the right choice. * Facilitate technical working sessions directly with partner engineering teams. **Personal Attributes:** * Recognize patterns and turn novel solutions into repeatable practices. * Take ownership of complex, ambiguous work and balance strategic leadership with hands\-on execution. * Build trust and credibility across partner, Product, Engineering, Solutions Engineering, and commercial teams. * Invest in colleagues’ growth through thoughtful mentoring, design feedback, and code review. **What’s Next** --------------- After you submit your application, you can expect the following steps in the recruitment process: * Online Technical Test * TA Call * Live Coding (Virtual) * FinalInterview – Hiring Manager (Virtual or face\-to\-face) Compensation Range: $200K \- $240K

jobs.title: Manufacturing Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **The Opportunity:** General Dynamics Electric Boat, the world’s foremost designer and builder of nuclear submarines, is seeking an IT System Engineer supporting the Manufacturing organizations within the EB Information Technology (EBIT) Department in North Kingstown, RI. The current business needs and demands are ever rapidly changing and require an agile, flexible, analytical candidate to join EBIT. **Position Summary:** This IT System Engineer will as a blended role of both Forward\-Deployed Engineer and Business Analyst serving as a critical bridge between manufacturing operations, business stakeholders, and technical engineering teams. In this hybrid role, the individual embeds directly within production environments to analyze business processes, understand operational challenges, and translate those needs into scalable technical solutions. They work closely with manufacturing leadership, subject\-matter experts, and cross\-functional teams to ensure that digital tools, automation systems, and data\-driven applications are aligned to real\-world manufacturing workflows. This role combines deep analytical skills with hands\-on technical implementation. It requires gathering and refining requirements, mapping complex processes, and identifying opportunities to improve throughput, quality, and efficiency. The engineer side of the role includes configuring, deploying, and validating software or operational technologies on the factory floor, ensuring solutions are robust, and optimized for performance in high\-volume environments. The ideal candidate is adaptable, customer\-focused, and comfortable working in fast\-paced production settings. They excel at turning ambiguous problems into structured solutions and ensuring that deployed systems deliver measurable business impact. By serving as an on\-site technical partner and a strategic process analyst, this role helps accelerate digital transformation across the organization’s business systems. The position is primarily on\-site support, with some flexibility for part time remote work. It will include semi\-regular travel between other regional Electric Boat locations. Qualifications: **Required:*** Bachelor of Science in Engineering Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or Information Technology * 0\-5 years of post\-graduate engineering experience supporting manufacturing operations, process improvement, or technical solution deployment within an industrial or production environment **Preferred:*** Experience working in **large\-scale, multi\-site manufacturing environments**, especially those involving automation, complex supply chains, or regulated production processes. * Familiarity with **manufacturing execution systems (MES)**, ERP platforms or industrial automation interfaces. * Experience with **LEAN, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies**, including process mapping, root‑cause analysis, and operational optimization. * Understanding of **industrial IoT, edge computing, or digital manufacturing technologies**. * Proficiency with data tools, such as SQL, Python, Power BI, or similar platforms used for analysis, reporting, and troubleshooting Skills: * Ability to solve complex technical problems, while also distilling complex information to present to varying levels of management within the organization * Ability to consult clients/customer to configure systems in line with business needs * Ability to lead cross\-functional deployments, guide change management activities, and drive adoption of new tools or processes. * Comfortable working in on\-site production areas, including around heavy machinery, automated systems, and fast\-paced operations. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment and drive projects to successful completion

As GitHub's lexical and semantic code search engine, Blackbird powers context retrieval for business\-critical experiences across the platform and our Copilot products, including Cloud Agent, Code Review, Copilot CLI, and VS Code. We're looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to help develop, scale, operate and extend Blackbird. This role is specifically focused on infrastructure, operations, automation, CI/CD, DX, observability, and security. You'll be part of our Copilot Agents organization, positively impacting millions of software developers and AI agents around the world who are building everything from open source to global enterprises. We are looking for creative problem solvers and diverse thinkers, people who care about culture as well as customers and features. We believe that how we do things is as important as what we do. Big vision, a common purpose, passion for quality, curiosity, dedication, and investment in fun and collaboration are what lead to great results. Great products reflect the teams that build them. Helping developers navigate and understand that data is a core part of GitHub’s mission, and an area with significant potential we have only begun to realize. We have high aspirations for how we can help developers understand and navigate code, and for making collaboration more seamless. The foundation for these efforts is our purpose\-built code search engine which powers lexical and semantic code search in GitHub’s core search experience as well as GitHub’s Copilot products. The ideal candidate has strong experience with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, reliability engineering, as well as the ability to work autonomously, learn quickly, and communicate and set technical direction. You will be working within a strong team of staff and principal engineers as well as collaborate with partner teams across the Copilot Agents organization. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Factory: Code Security
jobs.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.* ### **An overview of this role** As a Senior Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Security team, you help developers find and fix security issues. Those issues live in the code they write and in the open source components they depend on. Your work spans complementary parts of a complete security analysis. On the dependency analysis side, you teach the analysis engine what a project depends on. You parse dependency manifests, lockfiles, and SBOMs so the engine knows which libraries and frameworks are in play and how the code uses them. You also extend the service that turns security advisories into automated merge requests that update vulnerable dependencies. On the vulnerability detection side, you grow GitLab's security analysis engine with hybrid analyzers that blend rule\-based detection and AI reasoning. You build and apply the tooling that develops, evaluates, and ships those analyzers, and you measure how well they find real problems. That work also expands coverage of the libraries, frameworks, and AI agent tooling that real\-world applications are built on. These threads reinforce each other. What a project depends on, and how its code uses those dependencies, are parts of one picture, and this team works across all of it. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Frontend
jobs.description: **About Glasslake** ------------------- Glasslake is building the operating system for SAP delivery — the infrastructure layer underneath the most complex and expensive IT projects companies run. SAP implementations move billions of dollars and thousands of consultants, but the knowledge generated in these projects is never captured: it lives in people's heads, disappears when the project ends, and gets rebuilt from scratch on every new engagement. Glasslake solves this with an agentic orchestration platform that coordinates every phase of SAP transformation, capturing decisions, tests, and context as a byproduct of work already underway — building an organizational memory that accumulates across projects instead of resetting. We're a team based in San Francisco and São Paulo, moving fast and already deployed with some of the largest SAP integrators in the world, including delaware Consulting, KPMG, and NTT Data. The team comes from Stanford, Meta, Two Sigma, Microsoft, and NASA. **The Opportunity** You'll build the interfaces consultants and enterprise teams use to navigate complex implementations and work with AI agents. These workflows involve substantial information, interconnected decisions, and work that unfolds over time. Your job is to make that complexity understandable and manageable through thoughtful, responsive software. You'll work closely with design and other engineers, and talk directly to customers to understand where they're encountering friction. You'll help shape what we build, prototype alternatives, ship improvements, and follow through on how they perform in production. Your primary focus will be the frontend: both the experiences users interact with and the foundations that help our team build them well. You'll have room to make consequential technical decisions and the responsibility to keep them practical — using AI\-assisted development tools to explore and iterate, while applying your own judgment to the quality and simplicity of what we ship. **What You'll Do** * **Own product outcomes.** Take ambiguous problems from customer conversations through implementation, deployment, and iteration. * **Build the core interfaces.** Ship the experiences consultants and enterprise teams use to navigate complex implementations and work with AI agents. * **Reason from UX back into implementation.** Decide which interactions need to feel instantaneous, how state and data should flow, and when a problem calls for a better component, a different loading strategy, or a change to an API. * **Design for real usage.** Think through loading, empty, error, and recovery states; collaborate closely with design; treat accessibility as part of a complete experience. * **Build durable foundations.** Recognize reusable interaction patterns, design clear component APIs, and use composition and shared primitives to keep the product consistent as it grows. * **Make the product feel fast.** Reason about rendering, network requests, caching, prefetching, and feedback during longer operations — and measure whether changes actually help. * **Work across boundaries.** Reason about APIs, data models, and backend behavior when they affect the frontend, and make pragmatic build\-vs\-use calls. * **Raise the team's bar.** Work independently, communicate decisions clearly, and improve the experience of engineers building alongside you — including how the team uses AI\-assisted workflows. **What We're Looking For** * **Deep frontend fundamentals.** You've shipped and maintained complex interactive applications, and understand JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS, browser behavior, rendering, state management, and asynchronous data flow. * **Strong UX judgment.** You think in terms of how people will actually use a feature, not just whether it works. * **Evidence\-driven.** You combine customer feedback with analytics, performance monitoring, and session replay to identify friction and evaluate the impact of changes. * **Ownership.** You ask questions, challenge assumptions, and care whether what you shipped actually helped, not just whether it shipped. * **Pragmatism.** You know when to use an existing library, when custom implementation is worthwhile, and how to balance immediate delivery with longer\-term maintainability. * **Curiosity and judgment.** Above all, you understand problems deeply, explore possible solutions, and make thoughtful trade\-offs between user experience, engineering quality, speed, and complexity. **Nice to have** * Experience building interfaces for AI\-powered products, including workflows where users review, guide, or approve agent actions. * Experience evolving a component library or design system while continuing to ship product features. * Experience on a small team where you helped shape product and design decisions alongside engineering. * Familiarity with complex enterprise workflows or ecosystems such as SAP, Salesforce, ERP, or CRM. **Why Join Glasslake Now** * Shape the interfaces for a product with proven traction inside the largest SAP integrators in the world — delaware Consulting, KPMG, and NTT Data — in a category being defined right now. * Own consequential technical decisions on a small, senior team, with a short line between an idea and it being in production. * Build the frontend foundations for a company with a team from Stanford, Meta, Two Sigma, Microsoft, and NASA. * Work at the center of an emerging category: interfaces where humans and AI agents collaborate on high\-stakes, high\-complexity work.

jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, and with data structures and algorithms. * 2 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. * 2 years of coding experience in C or C\+\+. * Experience with Operating Systems and Hypervisor. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with virtualization. * Proficiency in algorithms, data structures, complexity analysis and software design or expertise in Unix/Linux systems, IP networking, performance and application issues. * Knowledge of CI/CD best practices. * Software quality background, and pragmatism to apply it to one of the more complex testing/production qualification contexts Google has. * Comfort working in both engineering and operational environments. * A predilection to taking on challenges that bridge complex stakeholder contexts and take concerted, long\-term goal and investment. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions. Mission: To redefine the boundaries of cloud efficiency and security by evolving the virtualization layer for Technical Infrastructure (TI). By investing in Cloud Hypervisor (CHV) as our primary Rust\-based Virtual Machine Monitor (VMM), we aim to provide a streamlined, reduced\-surface\-area environment for creating VMs on TI hosts. Beyond the VMM, we are deepening our focus on hardware\-level isolation and I/O performance. This includes sophisticated IOMMU (Input\-Output Memory Management Unit) integration to secure DMA and interrupt remapping, ensuring hardware devices remain strictly confined to guest\-specific memory regions. We are building a virtualization stack that maximizes density and security without compromising on near\-native execution speeds. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Operating at the critical boundary between frontier ML models and future accelerator roadmaps, you will build and automate cycle\-level and analytical performance estimators to project throughput, latency SLOs, and Perf/TCO across different silicon configurations (SRAM/HBM hierarchies, multi\-dimensional ICI interconnects, optical switching, and specialized compute engines like SparseCore). jobs.description: **What's in it for you?** ========================= **Thanks to our commitment to creating a supportive and engaged workplace culture, Gorilla Glue has been recognized as a top place to work for 16 years in a row. We offer competitive compensation packages, comprehensive healthcare benefits, and other perks and incentives to ensure our employees feel valued and supported.**  **Joining the Gorilla Glue family means being part of a team passionate about building strong brands and promoting a culture of excellence. As an employee, you'll be able to help create high\-quality products and build brands that people love. Join us in an inspiring workplace where you can belong, grow, and make a difference!**  **Summary Description** The **Microsoft Platform \& AI Engineer** supports the implementation, administration, and continuous improvement of The Gorilla Glue Company's Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and AI\-enabled solutions that improve productivity, automate business processes and deliver measurable business value. This role is suited to a hands\-on Microsoft engineer who combines strong Microsoft 365 administration with practical experience building solutions in Copilot Studio and Power Platform. The position will translate approved business needs into secure, supportable agents, applications, workflows, and platform improvements. The successful candidate will work closely with business functions to identify and develop automation opportunities, deliver Copilot Studio agents and Power Platform solutions. They will collaborate with Enterprise Data Management, Infrastructure, Security, Application Services, Service Desk, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions in line with enterprise standards. The role operates under the direction of the **Manager \- Global MS Platforms** and is focused on the implementation, integration, support, and continuous improvement of Microsoft platform and AI solutions **What will your day look like?****Microsoft 365 Administration \& Platform Engineering*** Configure and support Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform capabilities to enable business productivity, automation, and AI\-driven experiences. * implement integrations between Copilot Studio, Power Platform, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online, and other approved Microsoft technologies. * Develop secure workflows, actions, connectors, and knowledge experiences that enable agents and AI solutions to interact effectively with Microsoft 365 services and business data. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues relating to Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft 365 integrations, permissions, data access, and platform services. **Copilot Studio \& AI Solution Development*** Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain Copilot Studio agents that address approved business needs. * Configure topics, generative orchestration, knowledge sources, actions, authentication, variables, and conversation flows to create effective agent experiences. * Integrate agents with Power Automate, Microsoft 365, Dataverse, approved APIs, Microsoft Graph and other enterprise systems. * Apply responsible AI, security, data protection, access control, and governance requirements throughout the solution lifecycle. * Perform testing, troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous improvement of agents based on usage, quality, risk, and stakeholder feedback. * Develop reusable patterns, templates, and components aligned to approved architecture standards. * Maintain awareness of emerging AI technologies, architectures, and best practices, and apply that knowledge to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise AI solutions. **Power Platform Solution Development*** Design and build business solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and other approved Power Platform capabilities. * Automate business processes, approvals, notifications, data capture, and integrations using secure and maintainable workflows. * Use solutions, connection references, environment variables, and appropriate application lifecycle management practices to move work through development, test, and production environments. * Configure roles, permissions, connectors, and data access in accordance with governance. * Support existing application s clearly to business stakeholders and provide practical recommendations and progress updates. **Governance, Security \& Operational Support*** Implement and support governance standards for Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and enterprise AI solutions. * Ensure solutions align with security, privacy, compliance, data governance, accessibility, and supportability requirements. * Participate in design reviews, testing, release planning, change control, incident resolution, and post\-implementation reviews. * Identify technical risks, platform constraints, licensing considerations, and support requirements, escalating decisions where appropriate. * Collaborate with IT teams and approved partners to resolve platform, integration, identity, data, or service issues. **Project Delivery \& Implementation*** Deliver assigned Microsoft platform and AI initiatives under the direction of the Managed – Global MS Platforms. * Own assigned project tasks and technical workstreams from discovery through implementation and transition to support. * Maintain clear plans, actions, risks, dependencies, testing evidence, and status updates. * Coordinate with users, technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support successful implementation and adoption. * Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery methods, standards, documentation, and reusable solution patterns. **What will you bring to the table?** **Education:*** Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered. **Required*** Minimum 3 years professional work experience * Demonstrated experience designing, building, testing, and deploying solutions in Microsoft Copilot Studio. * Strong practical delivery with Power Platform, particularly Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse. * Experience integrating Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft 365 Services, API’s, Connectors, SharePoint, Dataverse. * Experience designing AI\-enabled solutions, workflows, automations, and business process improvements using Microsoft technologies. * Working knowledge of environments, security roles, permissions, data loss prevention, solution management, and application lifecycle practices within Power Platform. * Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into technical solutions, prototypes, or production implementations. * Ability to troubleshoot agents, applications, workflows, integrations, identity, permissions, and data\-related issues. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to train users and explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. * Demonstrate ownership, organization, documentation, and problem\-solving skills. * Commitment to responsible AI, security, privacy, governance, and continuous learning. **Preferred*** Experience with SharePoint Online, MS\-102, or AI\-900\. **Company Values** Adhere to The Gorilla Glue Company’s Core Values that ensure everyone works together to exceed expectations:* Have fun, be passionate and show it. * Act with integrity and respect in all relationships. * Communicate openly and appreciate the effort of others. * Embrace knowledge, growth, and change. * Strive for excellence in what we do every day. engineering practices in cloud\-based environments preferred * Knowledge of software engineering principles, system architecture, Agile delivery methodologies, DevSecOps practices, cloud platforms, practices to improve developer productivity, software quality, operational efficiency, and delivery outcomes while maintaining engineering standards and appropriate human oversight. * Ability to lead software development teams through planning, execution, deployment, operational support, continuous improvement, and delivery of customer\-focused technology solutions. * Knowledge of engineering governance, software quality, application security, operational monitoring, incident management, and performance measurement within enterprise technology environments. * Ability to develop technical jobs.title: Principal AI Performance Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Job** ================= Set the performance direction behind large\-scale AI systems built for real deployment. As a Principal AI Performance Engineer, you will define how Graphcore analyzes and optimizes AI training and inference workloads. Your work will shape decisions across hardware, software, networking and system architecture. You will lead the hardest performance investigations, from model behavior to multi\-node scaling. You will turn profiling, benchmarking and modeling evidence into technical roadmaps and engineering priorities. You will set measurement standards, guide distributed communication strategy and review critical C\+\+ and Python tools. Your judgment will help teams make better decisions when data is incomplete. This role gives you rare influence across AI infrastructure at data center scale. It is based in Austin, Texas. **The team and culture** The System Engineering Performance team architects, evaluates and optimizes high\-performance infrastructure for large\-scale data center deployments. The team works across the computing stack to understand real system behavior. Work happens through evidence, technical ownership and direct cross\-team influence. You will guide strategy, resolve complex tradeoffs and raise performance\-engineering standards across the organization. Decisions are shaped by benchmarks, simulations, models and clear technical debate. The team values engineers who think big, act fast, take responsibility, speak up and lead beyond their own area. **What we're looking for** * Deep experience profiling and optimizing AI, machine learning or high\-performance computing workloads at scale. * Proven technical leadership across complex performance\-engineering or system\-architecture initiatives. * Expert C\+\+ and Python skills, including reliable tools or performance\-sensitive software. * Expert understanding of compute, memory, communication and scaling behavior in distributed systems. * Ability to define benchmarks, measurement practices or optimization standards across teams. * Experience with MPI, NCCL, UCX, libfabric, MLPerf, accelerated architectures or high\-performance interconnects. While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes. **Benefits** Graphcore offers competitive compensation and benefits designed to support employees' health, financial well\-being, work\-life needs, and professional growth. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. The role owns the platform architecture and complex administration, leads tenant and domain strategy, coordinates with specialized partners, enables routine operations, and partners with business and jobs.title: Director, Data Strategy & Governance
jobs.description: Healthcare Realty is seeking a hands\-on Director, Data Strategy \& Governance to join our Data, AI \& Innovation team at our Nashville corporate headquarters. This role owns Healthcare Realty's enterprise data lake on Microsoft Fabric in Azure, leads a small team of developers who build in it every day, and does development work alongside them. The data lake is the enterprise source of truth for an exciting three\-year program of AI\-accelerated applications and agentic AI solutions. We offer a competitive compensation package, including an annual bonus opportunity and comprehensive benefits. To learn more about our benefits, visit www.healthcarerealty.com/careers/. Healthcare Realty is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, including Minorities, Women, Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities. Healthcare Realty is on a journey to deliver AI\-accelerated applications and agentic AI solutions across the business. Every one of them depends on trusted, well\-governed data. The data lake is that foundation: the single source of truth for property, tenant, lease, financial, and operational data, and the place where our applications and AI agents will find the information they need to do their work. The initial data lake is established. It was built on Microsoft Fabric with a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) architecture by a third\-party implementation partner and integrates our core property management, leasing, and financial systems. You will take over ownership of the platform from that partner, lead the knowledge transfer, and continue to build on it as business and AI needs grow. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will lead direct reports who do daily development work in the data lake, and you will do development work yourself: designing pipelines, writing transformations, modeling data, and reviewing code. You will also own data governance, including data quality, lineage, master data, and access controls, so that the data is trusted for financial reporting, executive decisions, and AI. This role reports to the Vice President, Data, AI \& Innovation, a seasoned executive leader who has built and led data and AI organizations at global enterprises and is committed to mentoring and developing the people on the team. This is a hybrid position, with four days per week in our Nashville, Tennessee headquarters and one day remote. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Own the enterprise data lake on Microsoft Fabric, including its architecture, pipelines, data models, environments, performance, capacity, cost, and day\-to\-day reliability. * Lead the transition of platform ownership from our third\-party implementation partner, including knowledge transfer, documentation, runbooks, and a clear plan for what the internal team owns and when. * Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and transformations across the bronze, silver, and gold layers using Fabric Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, notebooks (PySpark and SQL), lakehouses, and warehouses. * Write production code alongside the team and set the standard for code quality, testing, documentation, and peer review. * Extend the data lake with new sources and data domains as business and AI needs grow, prioritizing the work with business stakeholders and technology leadership. * Build and maintain the curated data models and Power BI semantic models that support financial reporting, executive dashboards, and internal applications. * Prepare the data lake to serve AI\-accelerated applications and agentic AI solutions, including governed, well\-documented data products and reliable access patterns for applications and AI agents. * Establish DevOps practices for the platform, including source control, deployment pipelines across development, test, and production environments, release management, and monitoring. * Own the data governance program, including data ownership and stewardship, business definitions, the data catalog, and certified metrics. * Define and enforce data quality rules, monitoring, and issue resolution so that data is trusted for financial, operational, and AI use. * Maintain end\-to\-end lineage from source systems to reports and applications using Microsoft Purview or similar tools. * Manage role\-based access, row\-level security, and controls for sensitive and SOX\-relevant financial data in partnership with Security and Internal Audit. * Lead master data management for core business entities such as properties, tenants, leases, and health systems. * Lead, coach, and develop two direct reports, setting clear priorities, assigning and reviewing work, and supporting their professional growth. * Partner with Finance, Accounting, Asset Management, Leasing, Investments, and application development teams to understand their needs and translate them into data solutions. * Manage relationships with platform vendors and implementation partners, and track platform capacity, consumption, and cost. * Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to technology leadership and business stakeholders. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. * 8\+ years of hands\-on data engineering or data platform experience, including 2\+ years leading or mentoring a team of engineers or developers. * Hands\-on experience building and supporting data solutions in Microsoft Fabric or Azure data services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage, or Azure Databricks. * Strong SQL and Python (including PySpark) skills, with a track record of writing production\-quality code. * Experience designing lakehouse or data warehouse architectures, including medallion architecture, dimensional modeling, and star schemas. * Experience implementing data governance, data quality, lineage, metadata management, and access controls. * Experience building Power BI semantic models and DAX measures. * Experience with source control, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management for data platforms. * Experience taking ownership of, stabilizing, and extending a platform built by another team or vendor. * Ability to explain technical topics clearly to business and executive audiences. * Strong ownership, organization, and follow\-through. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience preparing data for AI and machine learning use cases, such as retrieval\-augmented generation, vector search, or AI agents. * Microsoft certifications such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP\-600\) or Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP\-700\). * Experience with Microsoft Purview or another enterprise data catalog. * Experience with master data management tools and practices. * Experience in commercial real estate, REITs, or financial services, including property management and leasing systems. * Experience supporting SOX controls or audited financial reporting in a public company.

supportability. ### **Security, Compliance, and Continuity** * Implement and maintain practical cybersecurity controls, including endpoint protection, access controls, vulnerability management, and security monitoring. * Support centralized management and monitoring of IT systems, endpoints, network infrastructure, and deployed devices. * Maintain compliance with internal security policies and support security audits and SOC 2\-related requirements. * Participate in incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning and testing. * Maintain clear technical documentation and recovery procedures. ### **Operational Improvement and Planning** * Establish and track meaningful service levels, operational metrics, and team performance indicators. * Develop and maintain troubleshooting playbooks, technical documentation, and repeatable operating procedures. * Evaluate third\-party vendors and infrastructure tools for performance, cost, and fit. * Identify listed above are representative of the role. Missouri. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Experience Required** * 5\+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, network administration, technical support, or a related IT (Azure AD), MFA, and SSO. * Experience with endpoint management and device security, such as Microsoft Intune/Endpoint Manager and Defender or comparable tools. * Solid understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, including routing, switching, VPNs, and network segmentation. * Strong systems troubleshooting skills and the ability to serve as an escalation resource for complex issues. * jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: As a **Principal Data Engineer**, you will build and maintain the data pipelines that power AI model training and algorithm development for IDEXX inVue Dx and other AI\-powered diagnostic products. This is a hybrid role based out of our Westbrook, ME location, with a minimum expectation of 2 days a week onsite. The Data \& AI Center of Excellence (AI Enablement \& Model Operations) manages the data foundation behind IDEXX's AI\-powered diagnostics. You'll join the Data Engineering team, working hands on in Databricks, dbt, and Snowflake, and serving as a technical anchor for other engineers on the team. **In this role:** ----------------- \+ You will design, build, and maintain fault\-tolerant production data pipelines in Databricks and dbt Core, following the medallion architecture and SCD2 patterns already in place across the team. \+ You'll own delivery of a piece of the team's roadmap and partner directly with Data Science and MLE colleagues on what they need from the data. \+ Your day\-to\-day will include writing and reviewing code, tests, and documentation to a standard other engineers can build on. \+ You'll troubleshoot pipeline failures and data quality issues, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches problems early. \+ You'll contribute to Snowflake integration work, including federated connections and history tracking for source systems. \+ You'll mentor junior and mid level data engineers on code quality, data modeling, and platform best practices. \+ You'll review pull requests and pair with teammates on tricky problems. \+ You'll help scope and triage incoming Jira tickets, and flag when something needs to be escalated. \+ You'll take part in interviews for future hires on the team. \+ You'll partner with your manager on team standards for testing, deployment, and documentation. **Why this role matters:** -------------------------- The pipelines you build feed the AI models behind IDEXX inVue Dx and other AI\-powered diagnostic products, which help veterinary teams care for pets. This is a senior, hands on role with real ownership: you'll drive significant pieces of the pipeline from start to finish and set the bar for code quality and data modeling across the team. **What you need to succeed:** ----------------------------- \+ You have 7\+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related field, with real production experience. \+ You have strong SQL and Python skills and hands on experience with dbt. \+ You've worked with a modern cloud data platform (Databricks and/or Snowflake strongly preferred). \+ You're comfortable with CI/CD, version control (GitHub), and automated testing for data pipelines. \+ You've mentored or reviewed the work of junior and mid level engineers. \+ You've worked directly with Data Science, MLE, or other technical partners to understand what they need from the data. \+ You use good judgment about when to escalate, when to make the call yourself, and when to ask for help. \+ Preferred: Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated data environment. \+ Preferred: Experience with AI/ML training pipelines, or working closely with data science or MLE teams. \+ Preferred: Familiarity with medallion architecture, SCD2 patterns, or similar data modeling conventions. \+ Preferred: A track record of proposing and driving improvements to engineering practices or tooling, not just following the ones already in place. **What you can expect from us:** -------------------------------- This is a hybrid role based out of our Westbrook, ME location, with a minimum expectation of 2 days a week onsite. \+ Competitive Salary \+ Opportunity for annual cash bonus, if applicable \+ Health / Dental / Vision Benefits Day\-One \+ 5% matching 401k \+ 25 Holidays / year \+ Pet insurance \+ Additional benefits including but not limited to financial support, pet insurance, mental health resources, volunteer paid days off, employee stock program, foundation donation matching, and much more! This position is critical to establishing scalable data models, pipelines, and governance practices that will support our growing analytical needs. The prime reason for this role's existence is to bridge the gap between raw data ingestion and analytics needs, ensuring that our analysts and stakeholders have access to high\-quality, well\-documented, and performant data models. This position directly contributes to the company's overall mission by enabling data\-driven decision making across all departments, improving operational efficiency, and supporting strategic initiatives through reliable analytics infrastructure. Key contributions to the company include: * Building standardized data models that reduce time\-to\-insight for business users * Implementing data quality and governance frameworks that ensure information is accurate and compliant. * Creating reliable, well\-documented data pipelines that enable consistent reporting and analytics across all business functions **What You'll Do** **Data Modeling and Pipeline Development** * Design, build, and manage data models and ELT/ETL pipelines to transform raw data into structured formats within Snowflake using dbt * Create conform and analytics layers that standardize data for business consumption * Develop dimensional models and data marts tailored to business requirements **Data Quality and Governance** * Implement best practices for data quality, integrity, and performance monitoring * Contribute to data governance frameworks, including maintaining data lineage and definitions * Establish data quality checks and validation processes within dbt workflows **Performance Optimization** * Optimize data storage and retrieval processes within Snowflake to ensure scalable, reliable, and cost\-effective data solutions * Fine\-tune SQL queries and data transformations for optimal performance * Monitor and improve pipeline efficiency and resource utilization **Technical Documentation** * Create and maintain clear, comprehensive documentation for data models, processes, and key metrics * Document data lineage and maintain metadata for analytical datasets * Establish documentation standards and best practices for the team **Software Engineering Practices** * Leverage version control and CI/CD pipelines for streamlined, reliable development processes * Ensure code quality through testing, peer reviews, and automated deployment **Collaboration and Stakeholder Management** * Work closely with analysts and business subject matter experts to understand requirements * Translate business needs into effective technical data solutions * Participate in regular stakeholder meetings to refine and expand data capabilities **What You Bring** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems or a related field * 2\-4 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar role * Advanced SQL proficiency in ANSI\-SQL for querying, data transformation, and building data infrastructure * Snowflake expertise with hands\-on experience in its architecture and best practices for data management and processing * Strong data modeling skills with deep understanding of data modeling principles and experience designing efficient structures for analytics * dbt proficiency for managing data transformations and building data models within Snowflake * Passion for detail and quality \- skilled at spotting data and process gaps and committed to driving continuous improvement * Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating with non\-technical stakeholders * Intellectual curiosity and drive to understand business problems through data **Preferred Qualifications** * SnowProcertification or equivalent advanced Snowflake expertise * Experience with modern cloud data architecture (data lakes, data lakehouses, cloud data platforms) * Experience with ELT/ETL tools (Fivetran experience a plus) * Knowledge of data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) * Previous experience in insurance, finance, or regulated industries * Python programming experience for data parsing, transformation, and scripting within data pipelines Midwest Railcar is a leading provider of railcar leasing and transportation solutions, committed to delivering reliability, performance, and integrity across the rail industry. With decades of experience and a strong customer\-first philosophy, the company partners with businesses nationwide to supply high\-quality equipment and responsive service tailored to evolving logistics needs. Driven by a culture of excellence and accountability, Midwest Railcar emphasizes innovation, operational efficiency, and long\-term relationships. Interns joining our team gain hands\-on exposure to a dynamic industry, working alongside experienced professionals who are dedicated to keeping essential supply chains moving safely and efficiently. FOR OUR ASSOCIATES: * **At the office**: Based on your location, we offer parking and commuter benefits programs to help make your commute a little easier. * **Staying healthy:** Our wellness program, Wellworks, combined with our Employee Assistance Program (for when you need confidential support), help you keep an eye on short and long\-term goals and any bumps that pop up along the way. We are also proud to offer subsidies to support your health and fitness goals by providing gym membership subsidies. * **Preparing for your future:** We offer a 401(k) with a company match * **Company culture:** Our Associates are the foundation of our company and we want you to enjoy working here! With company lunches, corporate outings, or even the occasional ice cream truck, you never know what will pop up to make your day. * **Peace of mind:** Our insurance benefits include medical, prescription, dental, voluntary vision, voluntary life/dependent life, group term life, and AD\&D. * **Time to recharge:** We offer paid time off, along with paid holidays, in accordance with company policy and applicable laws. *The salary range for this position is $88,000 to $117,000\. If an offer is made, the pay rate determinations will take into account relevant market data and the applicant’s prior experience, education and other qualifications directly related to the position to ensure internal equity.*

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives. **Team Description** At Capital One, we are relentless innovators with a proven track record of transforming customers’ experiences and the financial services industry. jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Come join the Intuit GRC organization! We are looking for an innovative professional to join a world class team. We're looking for a motivated, technically fluent Senior Technical Compliance Manager who can sit at the intersection of compliance domain expertise and engineering execution: someone who understands SOC 1/2, access reviews, and control testing well enough to translate those requirements into concrete engineering tasks, and who can partner directly with engineers (or build the automation themselves) to ship it. This is not a traditional risk\-assessment TCM role. jobs.title: Sr. AI & Automation Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB216055 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **About the Team** The Future Forward organization is Intuitive's advanced concepts group. We explore emerging technologies, prototype next\-generation solutions, and build software experiences that shape the future of robotic\-assisted surgery. Our research team is building advanced augmented dexterity capabilities for next\-generation robotic platforms. **The Role** Our researchers should spend their time on ideas, not on the manual work required to turn those ideas into results on real robots. As a Senior AI \& Automation Engineer, you will build the AI tools, automation systems, integrations, and evaluation capabilities that help researchers and engineers train, test, and evaluate models faster and make better decisions. You'll leverage existing AI technologies while developing new solutions, from agent\-driven workflows and AI tooling to the APIs, services, and automation frameworks that support engineering and research activities. That could mean agents that set up and run experiments, automation workflows that accelerate testing and evaluation, or tools that sort through logs and video to help teams understand failures and improve outcomes. It's a hands\-on engineering role that uses AI to improve how physical AI systems are trained and tested. You'll automate that work; you won't design the models themselves. You'll work closely with ML researchers, simulation engineers, and robotics engineers. **What You'll Do** * Build and integrate AI tools, APIs, and agent workflows that automate engineering and research work across the team. * Automate the training and fine\-tuning workflow, from setting up experiments to launching, tracking, and comparing runs, so researchers can reproduce results without hand\-built scripts. * Build automation and integration workflows that help researchers and engineers evaluate new ideas in simulation and on real robots, quickly, reliably, and at scale. * Design evaluations and experiments that show, with statistical confidence, whether a change is a real improvement. * Build logging, analysis, and debugging tools that help the team understand results and failures, and that turn robot sessions into data the team can train on. * Make what you build reliable, secure, and safe to run, with human approval where it matters and responsible use of AI throughout. * Evaluate emerging AI tools, models, and technologies, and bring in the ones that deliver measurable impact. * Measure the impact of what you build, document it clearly, and make successful tools part of how the team operates. ### **Qualifications** **What You Bring** We care more about real depth in a few of these areas than shallow coverage of all of them. * Hands\-on work with real robots. You've built testing, automation, or evaluation systems that ran on real robot hardware or other physical systems via software interfaces, not only in the cloud or in simulation. * AI and automation you've built and put into daily use. You've built LLM\-agent workflows, AI tool integrations, copilots, or automation pipelines for real engineering work and measured whether they helped. Be ready to walk us through one: what it did, where it failed, and what you changed. * Evaluation and experimental rigor. You know how to design experiments and understand the statistics needed to determine whether an improvement is real. * Strong software engineering. You have 5\+ years of software engineering experience. You write production\-quality Python, can read C\+\+, and are comfortable with Linux, CI/CD, Docker, containerized services, APIs, and distributed systems. Strong candidates often come from robotics, autonomous systems, physical AI, or robot\- learning research, and have applied AI tooling to real hardware. You're comfortable working across disciplines in a fast\-moving research environment and can explain trade\-offs clearly to researchers gineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. * Advanced degree (MS or PhD) preferred. Bonus Points None of these are required. They're signals, not gates, and any one of them is a nice plus. * Robotics simulation, such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab or MuJoCo * Evaluating AI/ML, robotics, or robot\-learning systems * Surgical or medical robotics, including da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK) systems * ROS 2 or other robot middleware * Agent frameworks, tool integrations, or MCP servers adopted by engineering teams * AI assistants, copilots, or productivity tools built for engineers or researchers * AI applied to scientific, engineering, or research workflows ### **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. Details can vary by role. Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. Mandatory Notices U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743\.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status. Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6\+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process). For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws. Preference will be given to qualified candidates who do not reside, or plan to reside, in Alabama, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, or Tennessee. This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills. Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law. Accommodation \& Accessibility Notice: Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com. We provide market\-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity.
