management. * Experience with SCIM or automated user provisioning, and with role mapping from identity provider groups. * Prior work on multi\-tenant SaaS products, including per\-tenant branding or configuration. * Familiarity with Azure services, Azure DevOps or other CI/CD tooling, and applications hosted on Windows Server/IIS. * Experience with audit logging, observability (logging, monitoring, correlation IDs) and performance profiling. * Experience designing and building APIs for partner or third\-party integrations. * Experience replacing or modernizing legacy systems. * Prior consulting or contract engagements where you joined a team mid\-stream and handed work off to a client team. * Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.

jobs.title: Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer - US (Full Time)
jobs.description: **About Very** ============== *(Remote – United States)* ========================== Very is a fully distributed technology firm led by expert problem\-solvers who create efficient, scalable solutions that move commercial, industrial, and consumer products from pilot to production in record time. We believe that real innovation happens **in the grind** — working shoulder to shoulder with clients who are building the future. Our team thrives on that energy. When we’re not helping clients deliver business\-critical outcomes, we’re refining our craft and celebrating what it means to do hard things well. We’ve built a collaborative, tight\-knit culture that thrives in both remote and in\-person settings. We’ve won numerous workplace awards over the years, including Great Place to Work certification and recognition from Parity.org as a Best Company for Women to Advance. Our clients include well\-known brands like Vizio, Peloton, Clear, iHeart Radio, and Fellowes — all determined to leverage connected devices and AI to drive meaningful impact. Our job is simple: **help them win.** **About This Role** We are seeking a Lead Firmware engineer with 8\+ years of professional embedded development experience who has deep expertise building production embedded systems on modern wireless MCU platforms such as Espressif ESP32\. In this role, you’ll own the device firmware stack end to end, from schematic review and board bring\-up through production firmware, OTA, and certification, while setting technical direction and mentoring the engineers around you. **What You’ll Be Working On** We dedicate each engineer to a single project in order to promote focus and minimize context switching. You will be developing production\-grade firmware for connected devices from bring\-up through production deployment and ongoing maintenance. You will own firmware development across the full device lifecycle, including schematic review, board bring\-up, driver integration, BLE provisioning, cloud connectivity, OTA updates, and certification readiness. You will also participate in hardware debugging and validation using tools such as JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, and protocol sniffers to diagnose low\-level issues across firmware, hardware, and network layers. You’ll lead firmware technical decisions and collaborate closely with hardware engineers, contract manufacturers, client stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to deliver production\-ready devices. This role involves debugging complex, real\-world interoperability issues across connected\-device ecosystems, requiring deep protocol\-level understanding and hands\-on problem solving. **Responsibilities** * Own firmware architecture and technical direction, making key design decisions and tradeoffs * Serve as the primary firmware point of contact for the client, translating product requirements into technical plans and estimates * Plan and prioritize firmware work, identifying risks and dependencies early * Lead code reviews and set firmware coding, testing, and release standards * Mentor and guide other engineers on the team * Design, develop, and maintain production firmware for ESP32\-based connected devices using ESP\-IDF * Bring up new hardware and integrate drivers for sensors, actuators, LEDs, and other peripherals * Implement BLE provisioning, Wi\-Fi connectivity, and secure cloud communication with AWS IoT Core over MQTT * Build and maintain reliable OTA update mechanisms, including rollback and staged rollouts * Debug and resolve issues across firmware, hardware, wireless, and cloud layers, from development through production * Partner with hardware engineers and contract manufacturers on factory flashing, device provisioning, and production readiness * Support certification (e.g., FCC) and hardware build phases (EVT/DVT/PVT) * Collaborate with mobile and backend teams on device data models, telemetry, and device\-to\-cloud interfaces * Establish standards for firmware CI/CD, test tooling, and technical documentation **Requirements** **Experience** * 8\+ years professional embedded/firmware engineering in C/C\+\+ * 2\+ years in a technical lead role, owning firmware architecture decisions, leading code reviews, and mentoring other engineers. * Experience working directly with clients or stakeholders to scope, estimate, and plan firmware work. * Significant experience with Espressif ESP32 platforms using ESP\-IDF, including RTOS\-based development, OTA update mechanisms, low\-level driver integration (I2C, SPI, UART, ADC, GPIO), and production firmware deployment. * Direct, demonstrable experience developing connected\-device firmware on modern wireless platforms such as ESP32, including Bluetooth Low Energy, Wi\-Fi, and related connectivity technologies. * Hands\-on experience with wireless communication stacks such as BLE and Wi\-Fi at the firmware level. * Experience debugging protocol\-level communication issues, wireless connectivity problems, device provisioning flows, and interoperability challenges in connected\-device ecosystems. * Experience connecting devices to cloud IoT platforms such as AWS IoT Core using MQTT over TLS, including certificate\-based authentication and device state synchronization. * Experience integrating sensors, actuators, and peripherals such as RFID readers, accelerometers, motion sensors, LEDs, and pumps. * Comfortable reading technical specifications and translating them into production\-quality firmware implementations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience leading firmware for a connected product from concept through mass production * Contributions to open\-source ESP\-IDF or nRF Connect SDK project * Background in adjacent protocols — Thread, Zigbee, Z\-Wave, BLE Mesh — demonstrating breadth across the connected device landscape * History of working in a consultancy or product development firm where they've shipped across multiple product lines, not just one internal product * Comfort with hardware debug toolchains — JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, protocol sniffers * Experience standing up CI/CD for firmware builds and automated test harnesses * Experience with Nordic nRF\-series platforms using nRF Connect SDK * Familiarity with embedded security concepts such as secure boot, flash encryption, key management, device attestation, and secure firmware updates * Experience designing OTA update strategies with rollback and staged rollouts * Experience working with contract manufacturers on factory flashing, device provisioning, and production readiness * Experience supporting hardware through EVT/DVT/PVT builds and FCC certification * Familiarity with Protocol Buffers or similar serialization formats for device messaging * Python scripting for test tooling and device automation **Skills** ---------- * **Client Obsessed:** Acts as the client’s trusted technical voice and keeps them confident in delivery. * **Communicates Clearly:** Turns complex technical tradeoffs into clear recommendations for any audience. * **Thrives in the Grind:** Leads from the front on hard problems and sets the bar for detail. * **Learns Relentlessly:** Grows fast and helps the team grow through mentoring and shared lessons. * **Brings Structure:** Sets the plans, standards and priorities that keep the team on track. **Compensation \& Benefits** **Base Compensation:** $175,000 USD, commensurate with experience. **Variable Compensation:** Up to 10% annual performance bonus \*\*Note: To qualify for this role, you must reside within the continental US and have proper work authorization. We do not sponsor work visas. **Perks \& Benefits:** * 401(k) match * 200/month cell phone \+ internet stipend * $600/year home office stipend * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid parental leave (95th percentile in the U.S.) * Professional development stipend * Loaned MacBook Pro * Annual team retreat **Why Work for Very** --------------------- We do not promise an easy ride — we promise meaningful work. We work hard because our clients’ success depends on it, and we take pride in delivering when others can’t. We collaborate closely, move fast, and stay grounded in results. We take joy in the process — in the problem\-solving, the iteration, and the shared wins that come from doing the hard things well. If you’re looking for a place where every project matters, where the standards are high, and where you’ll grow by pushing yourself and others — welcome to Very. Interviewing for a new company is a serious time commitment for all parties involved. Please take the time to read this and thoughtfully consider if we would be a good fit for one another. No contractors or agencies. Seriously. \#LI\-Remote **\*\*Note: To qualify for this role, you must reside within the region posted.** **\*\*Note: This role requires the ability to travel within the US as needed for client engagements.** **\*\*We do not provide visa sponsorship.\*\*** 2RgOiOWezM

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer Welding Production Extra-Ordinaire
jobs.description: Are you passionate about designing, developing and optimizing manufacturing processes? Do you have a continuous quality improvement mind\-set and high degree of integrity? Do you understand the importance of creating a vibrant culture through building relationships with your team members? Are you a problem solver, team player, and amazing communicator? We are an established, solid, growing company in the manufacturing industry with a 50\+ year history of success. Our brand stands for quality, character, and relationships. We back our brand with exceptional quality products, world\-class customer service, individual and organizational growth, and industry\-leading standards. We have a strong foundation and a vibrant future ahead. We are seeking a Manufacturing Engineer "Extra\-Ordinaire" who will play a hands\-on active role in the future of our company. Our Manufacturing Engineer will be able to effectively multi\-task the demands of quality, manufacturing, and safety by working with our company’s leadership team to achieve a vision. Specifically, we are looking for the following characteristics and qualifications: * **You must naturally be a** “**people person.”** You must love dealing with and interacting with all kinds of people. You must come across as sincere, warm, genuine, and caring. * **You must be able to work Monday through Thursday** working a ten\-hour shift. We have three day weekends! Yes, you get Friday, Saturday and Sunday off every week! (There are times we are very busy! You will get paid time and half for overtime. This is Friday and Saturday work on occasion.) * **You thrive at taking on responsibility.** You organize your work and develop strategy to reach objectives. * **You have quality manufacturing and business acumen.** You understand that quality, accuracy, efficiency and safety processes drive our bottom line. * **You are proactive and self\-reliant.** You can follow directions *and* can think on your own filling in the blanks when necessary. If action is necessary, you discern the next right step while gathering the resources to move forward. * **You are emotionally mature.** You don’t get frustrated, defensive, easily overwhelmed, or take things personally when faced with adversity, deadlines, and conflicts. You also know how to help others overcome negative emotions and move forward toward resolution. * **You are conscientious.** You take pride in your work and want things done right! You don’t cut corners sacrificing quality. You are a human with serious quality character. * **You are assertive but not aggressive.** You are a self\-starter and great at following up and following through to the very end. You love feedback and are open to suggestions to get better. * **You want to lead a vibrant life.** You are a generally happy person. You smile easily, see the glass as at least half full and experience joy on the daily. * **You want to be part of something bigger than yourself.** Our products create infrastructure for our communities! We want someone who cares deeply about our mission and recognizes that relationships are the epitome of what we do. **If you are thinking this is me, great! Read on!** **Southern Fabricators has unique core values!** **1\. Promise It, Deliver It** Do what you say, and say what you mean. –No cutting corners—customers and employees should know they can trust you. **2\. Choose Right, Not Easy** Treat people with respect, from the shop floor to the front office. –Make decisions based on principles, not just profit. **3\. jobs.description: **About the Role** At WEX, a Software Development Engineer (SDE) Level 3 is a senior technical leader who designs complete services, solves complex integration problems, and drives the lifecycle of major initiatives from end to end. In this role, you will directly participate in WEX’s fast\-paced AI\-driven opportunities, acting as a key builder and strategist for next\-generation technology. You will champion internal AI adoption by helping build AI\-powered sofrware (using tools such as Google Gemini, AWS Agent Core, Claude, and other third\-party agentic integrations) while sharing education and coaching within the organization. **What You’ll Do** **AI \& Agentic Engineering** * **Agentic Workflows:** Design and deploy multi\-agent workflows within AWS Agent Core, effectively handling state management, memory persistence, and complex tool interactions. * **AI Leadership \& Enablement:** Help drive internal education and coaching initiatives for tools with as Google Gemini Enterprise; collaborate with external AI partners on new agentic opportunities. **Architecture \& System Design** * **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Design, build, and own the lifecycle of entire services and cross\-platform integrations. Proactively mentor SDE 1s and 2s, delegating work specifically to help them grow. * **Consensus Building:** Facilitate data\-driven discussions to resolve engineering disagreements, effectively de\-escalating "religious wars" about technology and ensuring "quiet" voices are heard in design meetings. * **Continuous Learning:** Rapidly learn and apply new languages or frameworks, lead knowledge\-sharing sessions, seek out critical feedback, and context\-switch effectively across workstreams when project parameters change. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
jobs.description: **Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)** ======================================================= Location: Remote (U.S.\-based) Preference given to CA, TX and FL Department: Engineering Reports to: VP of Engineering Starting Pay Range: $142k \- $170k/yr**Company Overview** -------------------- Work Truck Solutions is the operating system for the commercial vehicle industry. While the retail auto market is saturated with software, the $130B\+ commercial truck market was operating in the dark—until we turned on the lights. We are the only platform that connects the entire ecosystem: OEMs, upfitters, dealerships, and fleet buyers. By digitizing complex inventory data (chassis \+ upfits) and streamlining the supply chain, we don’t just help dealers sell trucks; we ensure American businesses get the mission\-critical vehicles they need to work. We are a team of innovators, disruptors, and problem\-solvers dedicated to one mission: removing the friction from the commercial vehicle industry. We are profitable, growing, and aggressively scaling our technology to remain the undisputed authority in this space.**The Role** ------------ This is a senior, hands\-on remote role for someone who has built test automation programs before and wants to build the next one with AI at the center. You will own how we test our products end to end: the Playwright suite that covers our dealer software, our internal admin tools and Comvoy.com, the way tests get written and maintained, and the path from a pull request to a release we trust. Our engineering team is moving to an agentic way of working, where much of our code is written by AI agents under human review. That only works if our tests catch what the agents get wrong, and you will be the person who makes that true. You will use AI to write, expand and maintain test coverage far faster than a team could by hand. Just as important, you know when not to test. AI makes it easy to generate thousands of tests, and 10,000 Playwright tests is far more than our application needs. You will judge every test by the value it provides and remove the ones that don’t earn their place. You will sit on our Platform team, next to the engineers who own our cloud infrastructure, pipelines and environments, and you will work across every product team. A large part of the job is people. You will mentor our existing test engineers, pair with them, review their work and help them become strong automation engineers who build with AI every day.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own the test automation strategy. Decide what gets tested at which layer (unit, API, end to end) and drive automated coverage until it is the main way we know a release is safe. Define the measures that show progress, such as coverage, flake rate, run time and escaped defects, and report on them. * Decide what is worth testing. Set a clear bar for test value: what risk a test covers, what it costs to run and maintain, and whether a cheaper test at a lower layer would do the job. Review the suite against that bar regularly and delete tests that fall below it, including AI\-generated ones. * Build and scale our Playwright suite. Lead the architecture of our TypeScript Playwright framework: page objects, fixtures, test data, environment handling, parallel runs and reporting. * Use AI to build and expand automation. Use AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code or similar) to write new tests, convert manual test cases and legacy tests, triage failures and fix flaky tests. Build the prompts, rules, skills and agent workflows that let the whole team work this way. Set the review standard for AI\-generated tests so they check real behavior, not just pass. * Explore agentic testing. Evaluate and pilot newer approaches, such as agents that explore the application, generate test plans from requirements or repair broken locators. Bring in what works and drop what doesn’t. * Mentor the QA team. Coach our test engineers on automation design, Playwright and AI\-assisted workflows through pairing, code review and hands\-on teaching. You are measured on how much the team improves, not only on the tests you write yourself. * Build testing into the pipeline. Work with Platform engineers to run the right tests at the right stage of CI/CD, on short\-lived test environments, with fast and reliable feedback to developers. Help us gate deployments on test results we trust. * Partner with developers. Help product engineers write testable code and own their own tests, including the test attributes and contracts that keep UI tests stable as the product changes. * Collaboration. Communicate clearly with a distributed team, raise quality risks early and work well with both technical and non\-technical partners. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- We are looking for a very senior engineer. jobs.description: **Staff Software Engineer** =========================== Location: Remote (U.S.\-based) Preference given to CA, TX and FL Department: Engineering Reports to: VP of Engineering Starting Pay Range: $180k \- $230k/yr**Company Overview** -------------------- Work Truck Solutions is the operating system for the commercial vehicle industry. While the retail auto market is saturated with software, the $130B\+ commercial truck market was operating in the dark—until we turned on the lights. We are the only platform that connects the entire ecosystem: OEMs, upfitters, dealerships, and fleet buyers. By digitizing complex inventory data (chassis \+ upfits) and streamlining the supply chain, we don’t just help dealers sell trucks; we ensure American businesses get the mission\-critical vehicles they need to work. We are a team of innovators, disruptors, and problem\-solvers dedicated to one mission: removing the friction from the commercial vehicle industry. We are profitable, growing, and aggressively scaling our technology to remain the undisputed authority in this space.**The Role** ------------ This is a remote Staff Software Engineer role, our senior individual\-contributor track, and the bar is high. A senior engineer is measured by the work they ship; a staff engineer is measured by what the team ships because of them. You are the person others look to when the problem is hard, the requirements are unclear, or the stakes are real. You set technical direction that reaches beyond a single team, choose the patterns others build on, and take the ambiguous, high\-impact work that has no obvious owner and drive it to done. Our engineering team is moving to an agentic way of working, where much of our code is written by AI agents under human review. You will help lead that shift. You know how to build and maintain the skills, agents and context that make AI agents useful on a real codebase, and you set the standards that keep what they produce correct, secure and maintainable. You define how the team builds with AI, not just which tools it uses. This role is backend focused. You will spend most of your time in .NET and SQL Server, and you will know the frontend well enough to own a feature end to end. You will work day to day inside a software development team of 4\-5 engineers, but your influence extends across teams. You make the engineers around you better through the standards you set, the reviews you give, and the way you teach. You have a bias toward action: you would rather ship something real, learn, and correct than debate an abstraction for a week.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Technical leadership across teams. Own the technical direction for your domain and influence it across teams. Make architecture decisions end to end, advocate for the better way to do things, and mentor engineers well beyond your own squad. * Lead AI\-driven development. Build and maintain the skills, agents, rules and context (such as MCP servers and the documentation agents read) that let the team build with AI. Use AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code or similar) to speed up delivery and to refactor and migrate code at scale. * Set the standard for AI\-generated code. Define how agent\-written pull requests are reviewed and tested, including agentic testing, so that speed does not cost correctness, security or maintainability. * Raise the team’s AI fluency. Teach engineers to work this way through pairing, code review and shared tooling. Evaluate new tools and measure whether they actually help. * Drive the hard, ambiguous work. Take the projects that lack a clear owner or a clean spec, define the plan and the tradeoffs, and lead them to a shipped result. * High\-quality output. Build secure, scalable, high\-performance applications with a strong focus on maintainability and clean architecture, and set the standard the team builds to. * Lead through writing and specs. Write clear technical specifications to frame and lead a project. Establish the performance metrics for your domain, and make sure observability and reliability are designed in, not bolted on. * Set and enforce quality. Own coding standards and lead peer code reviews. Use reviews and pairing to teach, not just to gate. * Collaboration. Communicate clearly with a distributed team, surface issues early, and work fluently with both technical and non\-technical partners. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- We are hiring a backend\-focused engineer, and .NET is required. You must be expert in .NET (C\#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API) and SQL Server, with a working foundation in frontend development. Beyond that depth, we expect:* A staff\-level track record. Years of building and operating production systems, with a clear history of raising the bar on the teams you have been part of. * AI development process experience (required). You know what skills and agents are, and you have built and maintained them for a real codebase and team. You can talk about that work in specifics: skills, agent configurations, rules or MCP integrations you wrote, how you kept them current as the code changed, and a time AI\-generated code went wrong and how you caught it. You have a point of view on where these tools help, where they get in the way, and how to review what they produce. * Full\-stack range. Backend is your home, but you can own a feature from the database to the UI. * Strong Git workflow. Branching, pull requests, and code reviews are second nature. **Backend Depth** ----------------- This is the core of the role.* Years of building and operating production\-grade systems in .NET (C\#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API). * Demonstrated ownership of scalable, fault\-tolerant, performance\-critical systems. * Strong experience designing API architectures (REST and/or GraphQL) with attention to versioning, maintainability, and real\-world tradeoffs. * Proven ability to handle complex system challenges, including: + Concurrency, data consistency, and race conditions. + Caching strategies (Redis, in\-memory) and invalidation. + Asynchronous processing and queue\-based architectures. * Deep expertise in SQL Server: + Schema design and data modeling. + Query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning. * Sound judgment on when to use an ORM versus direct SQL. * Experience with distributed systems and integrations, including: + Event\-driven architectures (queues, pub/sub). + Resilient integrations (retries, idempotency, failure handling). * Strong understanding of security fundamentals (JWT, OAuth, RBAC). * Experience with observability and production operations: logging, monitoring, debugging, and root cause analysis. * Experience deploying and operating systems in Azure (App Services, Functions, Service Bus, Redis) preferred. * Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar). **Frontend Foundation** ----------------------- * Experience building production web applications with React and/or Svelte / SvelteKit. * Proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript. * Comfortable with component patterns, application state, and integrating UIs with REST/GraphQL APIs. * NodeJS experience is a plus. **Nice to Have** jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer / Tools Developer
jobs.description: **Who Are We?** XNRGY Climate Systems is a North American leader in sustainable HVAC solutions and advanced manufacturing of custom air treatment systems. We design and manufacture energy\-efficient climate systems for applications including data centers, healthcare facilities, industrial buildings, and other mission\-critical environments. **Position Overview** The Senior Software Engineer, Selection Engine \& CPQ builds the software behind how we select, configure, price, and deliver cutting\-edge chiller and data center cooling technologies. Based in Mesa, AZ and reporting to the Manager, CPQ Tools \& Selection Software, this role turns engineering models and product data into reliable commercial selections across chillers, CRAHs, and fan coil walls. This is a highly technical, hands\-on role at the intersection of software and mechanical engineering. You’ll own the software that connects engineering models and test data to the downstream users who rely on it, while also establishing the Git\-based development environment the team will build on. **An Overview of your Responsibilities!** * **Selection Engine:** Develop the calculation engine for engineering models, numerical solutions, performance calculations, and product selection workflows. * **Configuration \& CPQ:** Implement configuration, rules, constraints, pricing, and selection logic across complex product configurations. * **Performance Data:** Design and maintain performance databases, data models, versioning, validation, and traceability. * **Engineering \& Testing:** Integrate test\-stand data and tools for performance correlation, data validation, and model deployment. * **Selection Process:** Shape the user interface and workflows used by Sales and Applications, including validation, errors, warnings, and quote recall. * **Technical Deliverables:** Automate performance reports, submittals, equipment schedules, drawings, and other technical packages. * **Systems Integration:** Connect selection software with CRM, ERP, PLM/PDM, pricing, BOM, and related engineering systems. * **Product Architecture:** Create scalable software architecture that supports both bounded product configurations and highly modular product families. * **Software Reliability:** Establish testing, version control, release, deployment, and reproducibility practices for production\-critical engineering software. **What you’ll need, among other things!** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated experience. * 7\+ years developing and maintaining production engineering, scientific, numerical, industrial, or other technically complex software. * Defensible fluency in C\# and VB.NET, with the ability to build, extend, and modernize established calculation codebases. * Practical experience with numerical methods including iterative calculations, convergence, interpolation, optimization, or other engineering and scientific computation. * Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema design, data modeling, migrations, indexing, and query optimization. Experience with PostgreSQL and MySQL is highly valued. * Proficiency with Git, automated testing, code review, release management, and deployment, with a track record of building reliable production software. * Experience translating engineering specifications into software and collaborating directly with mechanical, applications, testing, and other technical teams. * Experience with product configuration, engineering selection software, or other software supporting complex engineered products. * Experience integrating software with test\-data pipelines, ERP, CRM, PLM/PDM, or technical document generation systems. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, industrial equipment, manufacturing, energy systems, or other engineered products is strongly preferred. * Experience with automated technical document generation, including LaTeX, templated PDF pipelines, or equivalent. * Familiarity with refrigerant property libraries such as CoolProp or REFPROP. * Exposure to ASHRAE Standard 205 / SSPC 205 data exchange formats. **Why Choose XNRGY?** At XNRGY Climate Systems, you’ll be part of a fast\-growing organization helping transform the climate systems industry through sustainability, innovation, and advanced manufacturing. You’ll have the opportunity to lead and develop a growing Supplier Quality Engineering team, influence supplier performance and operational excellence, collaborate with talented cross\-functional teams, and play an important role in supporting XNRGY’s continued growth.

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer

SPECIAL SKILLS * Ability to develop and implement automation solutions across the software development lifecycle in regulated, large\-scale environments. * Strong Python and SQL skills; familiarity with RESTful APIs, microservices, and event\-driven architecture; and experience with workflow orchestration (queues, schedulers, asynchronous jobs, retries, and observability). * Working knowledge of healthcare data and interoperability concepts (HL7 v2, FHIR) and experience integrating automations with EHR systems (Epic) is highly desirable. * Proficiency with CI/CD, Git\-based development, testing practices, and containerization technologies (Docker; Kubernetes preferred) is a plus. * Ability to create clear technical documentation (specs, runbooks, diagrams), support troubleshooting/root\-cause analysis, and communicate effectively with non\-technical stakeholders. PHYSICAL DEMAND On\-call: Participates in a scheduled on\-call rotation for production automations and integrations. Includes nights/weekends/holidays as scheduled; responds according to department SLOs and incident severity. jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ Zillow Experience Design (ZxD) shapes how people discover, buy, sell, and rent homes. Design Foundations brings together design systems, digital accessibility, brand and visual language, content standards, and the AI\-enabled tools increasingly used by Product, Design, and Engineering teams to design and build products. Zillow’s design systems, known internally as Constellation, span Web, iOS, Android, and Email. They give teams the shared components, patterns, and guidance they need to build with greater consistency, accessibility, and efficiency. **About the role** ------------------ We’re hiring a Principal Product Manager to shape product strategy for two foundational capabilities that influence how Zillow teams build across every customer experience: design systems and digital accessibility. As the first dedicated Product Manager across these areas, you’ll own product strategy and the integrated roadmap for design systems, and lead the product approach to accessibility systems, tooling, and product health. You’ll build the measurement systems and operating model needed to manage both as products. Zillow is accelerating AI\-native product development and launching its first enterprise accessibility policy. Your work will help determine how designers, engineers, and product teams use shared systems, tooling, and standards to build faster, more accessible, and higher\-quality products. You’ll partner closely with design systems and accessibility leadership, Foundations designers and engineers, program leads, and leaders and teams across Product, Design, and Engineering. **In this role, you will** **Lead design systems product strategy and roadmaps** * Define and lead the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Zillow’s design systems. * Define and mature the data, success metrics, and measurement needed to manage product performance, demonstrate customer and business value, and guide roadmap and investment decisions. * Prioritize investments that create leverage across teams, balancing new capabilities, adoption, system quality, support, accessibility, technical investment, and long\-term scalability. Stay current on evolving design\-system practices, accessibility standards, and AI\-enabled development, translating material shifts into roadmap and investment decisions. * **Understand customers and drive adoption** * Build a deep understanding of how designers, engineers, and product managers use our foundational systems to build products, including their workflows, needs, and friction points. * Use internal customer discovery, adoption data, and product\-health insights to inform roadmap decisions. * Identify barriers to adoption and prioritize product, tooling, workflow, and enablement improvements that create the greatest leverage. Lead alignment across Design, Engineering, Product, and senior stakeholders on priorities, trade\-offs, dependencies, and the value the systems deliver. * **Scale accessibility through systems** * Define product strategy and priorities for accessibility systems, tooling, and product\-health capabilities. * Develop the product approach to accessibility health observability, tooling, and integrations that help teams understand and improve the accessibility of Zillow’s digital experiences. * Evolve systems for automated accessibility checks (e.g., CI/CD checks), audits, and remediation so product teams can identify and own issues earlier. * Use audit findings and other product\-health signals to identify systemic issues and determine when problems should be solved centrally through design systems, tooling, or shared development mechanisms. Partner with the Principal Program Manager for Accessibility to translate enterprise priorities and risk into scalable product investments. * **Evolve systems for AI\-native product development** * Ensure design systems and accessibility standards evolve for AI\-enabled workflows, making them easier for AI tools and agents to consume and apply. * Partner across Design Tech, Engineering, and DevEx to shape and prioritize AI\-enabled systems and tooling based on evolving technology, customer needs, product outcomes, and broader systems priorities. * Evaluate how AI\-enabled workflows affect adoption, accessibility, quality, and efficiency, and use those insights to inform future investment. This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for th cessible, inclusive digital products and motivated to deepen your accessibility expertise. * You have strong product judgment and can synthesize complex, ambiguous inputs into clear product direction, strategy, priorities, and trade\-offs. * You have experience using product data and measurement to understand performance, demonstrate customer and business value, and guide investment decisions. * You communicate clearly with working teams and senior leaders, build alignment on complex decisions, and influence partners and roadmaps without direct authority. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Person Data and AI Evaluations
jobs.description: ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute. You'll make things happen–fast. ### **Principal Product Manager, Person Data and AI Evaluations** ZoomInfo \| Product \| Core Data **About ZoomInfo** ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute, you'll make things happen, fast. **The Opportunity** ZoomInfo's Core Data team builds and maintains the person and company data that powers the Go\-To\- Market Intelligence Platform: hundreds of millions of contact records, resolved to the right person at the right company, kept accurate, and delivered to more than 35,000 customers. That data has always been produced by deterministic pipelines: take many competing sources, weight them, decay them, and select a winner per attribute. That model is being replaced. Core Data is moving to an inference\-default operating model, where an agent reads the full body of evidence for a record, applies our business policy, proposes the answer, and a deterministic verification layer decides whether it lands. Selection logic goes away; verification and evaluation are what remain. The product manager's job changes with it. Instead of writing requirements for hand\-built selection rules, you run the evaluation engine that decides whether the agent's output is good enough to publish, and you make it better every week. We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own Person Data outcomes end to end and to build the AI evaluation discipline that the whole Core Data team will run on. You inherit a live portfolio: person data quality (removing bogus or outdated executive contacts, unlinking contacts from the wrong company, title classification, email deliverability), person coverage and extraction, and the privacy roadmap for person data. You will carry that portfolio through the pivot from rule\-based selection to agent\-adjudicated records, and you will define how we know the new system is right. This is a role for someone who has shipped data pipelines and entity resolution at scale and who is already using AI every day to make data systems better. You should be as comfortable reading a golden set and an eval report as you are writing a roadmap, and you should be excited that our product managers commit code and work alongside agents as a normal part of the job. **What You'll Do** **Own Person Data end to end.** Set the strategy, roadmap, and monthly priorities for ZoomInfo's contact data: accuracy, coverage, freshness, and compliance. Own the outcomes and the metrics that prove them, from cleaning up bogus executive contacts and verifying employment through leadership extraction and person location. Partner with the Person Data product manager already on the team and with Privacy, Trust and Identity engineering to deliver the roadmap. **Build and run the AI evaluation engine**. Define what "correct" means for each attribute the agent emits. Curate golden sets and trap records with our research team, stand up LLM\-as\-judge gates, set the confidence thresholds that route a record to auto\-accept, auto\-reject, or human adjudication, and track precision, recall, and drift in production. Every model or prompt change to the person pipeline ships through the gate you own. **Drive the pivot from rules to agents**. Move person attributes, one at a time, from deterministic selection to inference over full evidence. Write the policy clauses the agent follows, the grading guides research uses to score it, and the acceptance rules the pipeline enforces. Decide the order, prove each step in shadow mode against the gold set, and retire the legacy logic when the numbers say it is safe. **Bring AI into the pipeline without tanking the data**. Introduce models where they earn their place and keep classical tooling where it wins: normalization, string similarity, registry lookups, deterministic rules. Reason explicitly about cost per row, latency, determinism, and auditability. Know when a bigger model is the wrong answer. **Treat entity resolution as the hard core.** Person\-to\-company matching, wrong\-company links, duplicate people, and identity across sources are the problems that make or break contact data. Bring a clear mental model for canonical identity, match confidence, and the cost asymmetry between a false merge and a missed match. **Own the privacy roadmap for person data.** Own the privacy roadmap for person data — suppression, opt\- out, and notification — with Legal and Privacy. **Build with the team, hands on**. Pr  and finish work in a fast\-moving, ambiguous, and frequently chaotic environment * Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to move between technical depth and executive narrative. **Preferred** Experience with contact, person, or identity data, or with B2B company data * Familiarity with privacy regulation as it applies to published personal data (GDPR, CCPA, DNC, and international notification regimes) * Experience with Claude or comparable frontier models, agent frameworks, and eval harnesses * Background at an AI research lab or an AI\-native data company **Who You Are** **AI\-native, not AI\-curious.** You use AI tools every day and you have opinions about where inference beats hand\-built logic and where it does not. You would rather over\-index on AI fluency and learn our data than the reverse. **An entity\-resolution thinker**. You see a data quality problem and immediately ask which entity it is about, what the canonical form is, and what evidence would settle it. **An evaluator by instinct.** You do not ship a model change without a gold set, a threshold, and a plan for what happens at ten times the volume. "We'll A/B test it" is not an eval plan. **A builder**. You prototype, you read code, you commit. You are comfortable being the person who inspects agent output at nine in the morning and tunes the prompt by ten. **Tenacious**. ZoomInfo is fast, distributed, and messy. Many teams touch person data. You go find the people you need, you drive to a decision, and you keep the team focused on the few things that matter while everything else flies past. **One team.** Honest, has the team's back, celebrates wins and losses together. **The Environment** You report to the Senior Manager of Product for Core Data and sit inside the Core and Global Data organization under the Chief Data Officer. Your day\-to\-day partners are Person Data engineering, the Match team, the Research organization that produces golden records, Data Science, and the AI engineer building the shared model\-and\-eval platform. Expect interesting problems: when is a "Vice President" an executive and when is it a mid\-level title? How do you unlink wrong\-company contacts at scale without losing the right ones? How do you prove an agent is more accurate than the rules it replaces, and how do you keep proving it after launch? **About us:** ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) is the Go\-To\-Market Intelligence Platform that empowers businesses to grow faster with AI\-ready insights, trusted data, and advanced automation. Its solutions provide more than 35,000 companies worldwide with a complete view of their customers, making every seller their best seller. ZoomInfo is committed to protecting your privacy when you apply for jobs with us. Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Notice for more details on how we handle your personal information. ZoomInfo may use a software\-based assessment as part of the recruitment process. More information about this tool, including the results of the most recent bias audit, is available here. ZoomInfo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and does not discriminate based on protected status. We welcome all applicants and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, age, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability status, religion, protected military or veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in accordance with legal requirements. For Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. ZoomInfo does not administer lie detector tests to applicants in any location.

jobs.title: Senior AI Inference Engineer - Model Optimization & Deployment
jobs.description: The Perception team is pioneering the development of a multi\-modality foundation model to drive the next generation of autonomous system intelligence. As a Model Optimization \& Deployment Engineer, you will focus on bringing highly efficient, production\-ready large\-scale models to our on\-vehicle stack. We are looking for experts with hands\-on experience in compressing, accelerating, and deploying complex models (LLMs, VLMs, or FMs) for power\- and thermal\-constrained vehicle SOCs. You will optimize the ML models, write custom CUDA kernels, and build highly concurrent inference code to ensure real\-time, deterministic execution on edge devices. ### **In this role, you will:** * Optimize large\-scale models (Multi\-Modal Sensor Fusion models, LLMs, VLMs) using advanced quantization (PTQ, QAT), pruning, mixed\-precision inference frameworks, and parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA). * Architect and implement model conversion and compilation pipelines using TensorRT for edge deployment. * Perform rigorous parity checking, accuracy recovery, and latency benchmarking between PyTorch frameworks and compiled edge binaries. * Develop and optimize custom ML OPs and TensorRT Plugins with efficient CUDA kernels to minimize latency and maximize memory bandwidth on AI accelerators. * Write production\-level, low latency, and memory\-safe C\+\+ and CUDA code for real\-time inference on vehicle systems. ### **Qualifications:** * Deep expertise in model quantization (PTQ, QAT) and mixed\-precision inference frameworks (INT8, FP8, FP4, BF16/FP16\). * Proven experience optimizing large\-scale models (Multi\-Modal Sensor Fusion models, LLMs, VLMs/VLAs) utilizing Efficient Attention mechanisms (e.g., FlashAttention, Linear Attention), KV\-cache optimization (e.g., PagedAttention) and Speculative Decoding. * Extensive experience with model conversion/compilation pipelines (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT, torch.compile) and performing rigorous latency benchmark and model quality parity valuation. * Proficiency in low\-level programming for AI accelerators, specifically developing and optimizing custom ML OPs and TensorRT Plugins with efficient CUDA kernel implementations. * Production\-level C\+\+ (14/17/20\) and Python programming skills, with experience developing concurrent, memory\-safe, real\-time inference code for edge devices. ### **Bonus Qualifications:** * Familiarity with SOTA autonomous driving perception algorithms (temporal 3D object detection, BEV, 3D Occupancy Networks) and multi\-modal sensor processing (Vision, LiDAR, Radar). * Experience with distributed training pipelines and model/tensor parallelism (PyTorch Distributed, Ray, DeepSpeed, Megatron\-LM) and runtime efficiency optimization for GPU clusters. * Experience with end\-to\-end autonomous driving paradigms (VLM/VLA models, Foundation models) and edge deployment technologies (e.g., TensorRT\-LLM). **Base Salary Range** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance. **About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team. Follow us on LinkedIn **Accommodations** If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter. ***A Final Note:****You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. We are looking for a Staff Technical Product Manager to own the roadmap for Oura's Business Technology Services (BTS) and Workato platform — the shared integration and automation infrastructure connecting our ERP, financial, commercial, and customer systems, feeding our Databricks data lakehouse and data mesh, and increasingly serving the AI agents that act on top of all of it. You'll partner directly with Business Technology directors and their stakeholders to turn underspecified platform demand into a single, clear, prioritized roadmap spanning both BTS and Workato. You'll bring real technical depth — enough to own the platform's API contracts, versioning, and integration\-pattern decisions (Workato versus custom AWS\-native build, sync versus event\-driven) yourself — while partnering with Enterprise Architecture and the team's Staff Integration Engineer on deep systems design. ### **What You Will Do:** * Own and continuously prioritize the BTS platform roadmap across Business Technology domains, converting underspecified business asks into a clear, sequenced backlog that unlocks scale, international expansion, and NetSuite decoupling * Align demand intake across BTS and Workato queues into a single structured, prioritized process, giving the team and its stakeholders one holistic view of integration/automation roadmap, planning, and priorities instead of disconnected backlogs * Partner directly with Business Technology directors and stakeholders (Finance, Supply Chain, Member Experience, Commercial, Corporate) to elicit and structure platform demand, replacing ad hoc requests with a transparent intake and prioritization process * Own the platform's API contracts, versioning, and integration\-pattern decisions (Workato vs. custom build, sync vs. event\-driven, batch vs. real\-time) — technical enough to make and defend these calls yourself, partnering with Enterprise Architecture and the Staff Integration Engineer on deep infrastructure and systems design * Build and defend the platform's narrative for executive and cross\-functional audiences, translating technical trade\-offs into what a given investment unlocks and what it costs * Partner with Enterprise Architecture on platform\-vs\-domain scope calls, including how BTS integration flows feed the Databricks data lakehouse and support the broader data mesh * Review and recommend the approach to requirements for MCP servers and AI agents supporting the BTS ecosystem, in partnership with AI Productivity Contribute to standing up the Integration \& Automation Engineering team, partnering with the Director on team structure, hiring, and the transition from contractor\-led to FTE\-led delivery * This is a remote role based in the US. ### **What you'll bring** * 10\+ years of technical product or platform management experience, including significant time owning infrastructure, integration, or API platforms rather than customer\-facing features * A strong technical background — comfortable writing or critiquing a spec (OpenAPI, event schema, contract) and defending a build\-vs\-buy or versioning call, while partnering with Enterprise Architecture on deep systems design * Working knowledge of the core AWS services an integration platform is built on (API Gateway, Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS) — enough to make informed build\-vs\-buy and design calls and speak the same language as the engineers building on them, without needing to provision or maintain the infrastructure yourself * Direct experience with iPaaS/integration platforms (Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, or similar) and with API design, versioning, and contract management * A track record of working directly with business and operations stakeholders to turn vague or informally\-articulated requests into clear, buildable requirements * A track record of owning a platform roadmap that serves multiple internal consuming teams, including running intake and prioritization across competing demand and disparate backlogs * Comfort negotiating sequencing and trade\-offs directly with senior (Director and above) stakeholders who each believe their need is the priority * Excellent written and verbal communication, with a demonstrated ability to translate technical trade\-offs into business terms for executive audiences * Demonstrated use of LLM assistants and agentic build tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable) in daily work — research, drafting, analysis, prototyping, and problem\-solving — with sound judgment about when AI is and isn't the right tool, and a habit of verifying output ### **Nice to have:** * It's a plus if you also have: * Experience standing up or governing an AI control plane, MCP gateway, or agent observability/policy layer * Experience with ERP integration or decoupling (NetSuite or similar) in a growth\-stage company * Familiarity with data lakehouse or data mesh architectures (e.g., Databricks) and how upstream integration design affects downstream analytics and data products * Experience transitioning a contractor\-run function into a permanent platform team ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: * Competitive salary and equity packages * Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources * An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends \& family * 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off * Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Region 1 $198,000 \- $233,000 Region 2 $180,000 \- $212,000 Region 3 $169,000 \- $199,000 A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location. We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. The provided salary depends on many factors, such as work experience and transferable skills, business needs and impact, location, and market demands.* At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI\-native, full\-stack, multi\-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer\-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer\-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built\-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real\-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM\-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. **Applying to Render** ---------------------- We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. **About the Role** As the Engineering Manager for Governance \& Access, you will lead the team responsible for building the security, governance, and access capabilities that let Render's customers manage teams, permissions, and environments with confidence as they scale. You'll design these capabilities for a world where agents, not just humans, operate on Render, turning emerging agentic use cases into simple, reusable platform primitives across identity, authorization, credentials, and delegation. The problems span traditional IAM and emerging agent infrastructure, which is what distinguishes this role from a typical security or IAM job. You'll shape the team's structure as much as its roadmap. You'll also join at a formative moment: the team is small, the architectural foundations are still being defined, and the systems you build will become primitives used across millions of users. **What You’ll Do** * Lead and grow the Governance \& Access team * Own the roadmap for governance, identity and access management, roles and permissions, and related compliance and security capabilities * Define how these capabilities extend to agents operating on Render, not only human users * Partner with the dedicated product and design partners already on the team to align roadmap with customer and platform needs * Build a strong hiring and interview process as the team scales, calibrating closely with recruiting and cross\-functional partners * Make key technical and architectural decisions for access, identity, and governance systems * Coach and develop engineers, through performance management and career growth * Coordinate with the adjacent Security team and the rest of the Growth and Expansion org as the platform evolves * Balance security, usability, and speed, making pragmatic decisions about where strong guarantees are required and where the team can iterate **What We’re Looking For** * Strong people leadership \- the top priority for this role * Comfort operating in ambiguity, with the flexibility to adapt and grow as the team's scope evolves * Experience building and scaling a team from an early stage * A track record of managing and developing engineers, including hiring and performance management * Ability to partner closely with product and design without needing to fill those functions yourself * Background from either a startup or a larger company is fine. What matters is the ability to operate at pace **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Experience in security, governance, or access management (IAM, RBAC, compliance) * Exposure to building for AI agents or agentic systems * Experience managing senior (IC5\-level) engineers * Background in developer platforms or B2B SaaS products This is an opportunity to help define what secure access looks like when software increasingly acts on behalf of people. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need. **Benefits** ------------ * 4 weeks of paid vacation. * 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return. * Long\-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans. * 100% employer\-paid medical coverage and 99% employer\-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well. * Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc. * Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy. * Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders. * Continuous learning benefits \& related support. *This position is generally not eligible for new visa**sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.* *Render is an equal\-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy\-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.* *We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.* *We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!* Render — CCPA Applicant Privacy Notice Render — GDPR Applicant Privacy Notice Compensation Range: $204K \- $250K

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description: ### **About Subsense** Subsense is a deep\-tech company developing the world’s first non\-surgical, bidirectional brain\-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. Our mission is to unlock direct communication between the human brain and AI \- starting with medical applications such as stroke recovery and moving toward cognitive enhancement for healthy users. Headquartered in Palo Alto, Subsense brings together leading scientists and engineers to redefine the future of human–machine interaction. Subsense · Remote first, Bay Area hybrid or on\-site later · Reports to Alex Karpman, Brand \& Marketing Lead **Engagement:** Independent contractor, starting with a 1\-month project estimated at 30 hours per week. Project scope: advance and finalize the brandbook, build social templates, create marketing materials for conferences, add slides to the master deck and create a new creative brochure. **Path to in\-house:** Depending on fit and business needs, Subsense may offer a full\-time, in\-house (W\-2\) Brand Designer position after the project. ### **The role** Subsense is building an AI\-native NanoBCI: a non\-surgical brain\-computer interface that uses nanoparticles instead of implants. We are a team of about 40 scientists and engineers across two Bay Area labs, starting with medical applications such as Parkinson's and ALS. Our brand has to feel human, calm and clinically credible while explaining deep science and vision to investors, clinicians, press and future patients. You will be the in\-house hand behind every Subsense visual. We have brand guidelines (palette, Sora and Inter type system, gradients, chart style, logo rules). Your job is to advance them, turn them into a working system and then use that system every week, fast and consistently. The work moves between two modes, and you should feel native in both. One day it is structured, clear and readable pitch deck slides that help investors follow complex science. The next it is creative, catchy and sometimes bold marketing materials that stop people at a conference or in a feed. Switching between them easily is the job. Today this work is spread across several agencies and freelancers. We are bringing all of it in\-house with one designer who knows the brand deeply, keeps clean source files and can turn a request around in a day when an investor meeting is tomorrow. ### **What you will do** * **Brand system:** build and maintain our Figma library (templates, components, icons, chart styles) so every file starts on brand * **Pitch decks and investor materials:** maintain the master pitch deck, make fast slide edits for fundraising, build one\-pagers and data room documents * **Presentations:** keynote and conference slides for our CEO and scientists, templates the whole team can use * **Social media:** monthly static posts, carousels, infographics and simple motion for LinkedIn and X, built on reusable templates * **Event and conference materials:** roll\-up banners, booth graphics, sponsor assets, signage, badges, printed programs, ready for print vendors * **Out of home and campaigns:** billboard and digital ad creative, from concept to print\-ready files * **Merch:** artwork and tech packs for caps, T\-shirts and gifts * **File hygiene:** every deliverable ships with an editable native file in our shared drive, named and versioned ### **You might be a fit if you** * Have a portfolio that shows brand systems, not just one\-off pieces, ideally including decks and print * Are fluent in Figma and Canva, and comfortable in Google Slides * Use AI image and video tools as part of your workflow and know where they help and where they hurt quality * Can take a messy request ("make slide 8 clearer, tomorrow") and ask the two right questions before you start * Care about typography, spacing and restraint * Are curious about neuroscience, biotech or deep tech * Are reachable during California business hours (Pacific Time) and can turn quick adjustments around the same day #### **Nice to have** * Experience with scientific or medical visuals * Packaging, merch or environmental design **How to Apply \& What to Expect** ---------------------------------- Submit your portfolio, weekly availability, and responses to four application questions, including why you’re interested in Subsense. Brief, thoughtful answers are welcome! We ask for more detail up front to keep the interview process focused and streamlined. Shortlisted candidates can expect: * **Recruiter screen** — 30 minutes over Zoom to discuss your experience, interests, and the role. * **Test tasks \+ Loom walkthrough** — Complete three short design tasks and present your approach in a recorded Loom video. * **Final hiring manager interview** — 45 minutes over Zoom to discuss your work, collaboration style, and any remaining questions. ### **Why You’ll Thrive** You'd be joining a small team developing a non\-surgical, bidirectional brain\-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. You’ll help translate early research into working technology, with the opportunity to influence both the platform and how we build it. **A few things that make this different:** * **Own meaningful technical work:** Take projects from early R\&D through functional prototypes, with room to test ideas, solve complex problems, and shape design decisions. * **Build across disciplines:** Work hands\-on with ultrasound, electronics, and instrumentation alongside scientists and engineers in neuroscience, nanotechnology, and AI. * **Help shape a novel platform:** Contribute to technology with the potential to restore neurological function and, over time, enable direct brain\-to\-AI communication. * **Make a visible impact:** Join a team where your contributions directly influence technical progress, with equity that lets you share in the company’s growth. Our work takes place across labs in Palo Alto and Mountain View. We offer a competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), commuter benefits, and paid time off. *Subsense is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/gSDPeiDsrN1VlDwf AI is changing how software gets built and how companies run, and we’re at the front of it. We're hiring a Software Engineer to own direction and architecture on our AI Operations Engineering team. Suno is scaling incredibly fast and our job is to unlock growth for operations areas like music ops, support, legal, finance, and beyond with workflows, tooling, and intelligent agents. **What You'll Do** * Build agents, workflows, and custom tools that let non\-engineering teams handle more without adding headcount * Evaluate and integrate third\-party tools, making the call on what to buy and what to build * Contribute to and empower stakeholders on our self\-service app deployment platform * Design and implement new patterns for internal APIs, auth and MCP building and extending beyond our Django monolith. * Integrate and scale customer experience systems built around third parties like Zendesk. * Partner with customer experience, legal, finance, people, and content ops to source new challenges **What You'll Need** **Must\-Haves** * You bring 2\+ years of full\-stack software engineering experience * You have a track record of building, maintaining, and supporting internal tooling or systems that streamline engineering or business operations * You’re eager to learn and share agentic coding best practices and tools * You thrive in an early\-stage, 0 1 environment where the problem space is still being defined **Nice\-to\-Haves** * You’ve worked with agent frameworks (e.g. LangGraph) and eval or observability tooling (e.g. LangSmith, Braintrust) * You’re familiar with support tooling, CRM systems, or workflow automation platforms Not sure you meet every point above? Please apply anyway! If you're excited about this work and think you could make an impact here, we'd love to hear from you. The best candidates rarely check every box. **Work Location Policy** This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full\-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits.
